```{=html}
<style>
#chord-sheet-root{
  --ink:#212529;--muted:#6c757d;--faint:#adb5bd;
  --border:#dee2e6;--border-strong:#ced4da;
  --primary:#2780e3;--primary-dark:#1f6fc4;
  --primary-tint:rgba(39,128,227,.08);--primary-tint-border:rgba(39,128,227,.4);
  --danger:#dc3545;--danger-tint:rgba(220,53,69,.07);--danger-tint-border:rgba(220,53,69,.4);
}
#chord-sheet-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
#chord-sheet-root{color:var(--ink);max-width:1200px;margin:1rem auto 2rem}

/* ===== cards & rows ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:.5rem;padding:1rem 1.15rem;margin:0 0 1rem;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
#chord-sheet-root .row{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}
#chord-sheet-root .row.tight{gap:.5rem}
#chord-sheet-root .row+.row{margin-top:.6rem}
#chord-sheet-root label{display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.3rem;font-weight:500}
#chord-sheet-root .panel-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
#chord-sheet-root .panel-sublabel{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem}
#chord-sheet-root .field-hint{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);margin-top:.3rem}
#chord-sheet-root .panel-rule{border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin:.75rem 0}
#chord-sheet-root .head-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}

/* ===== form controls ===== */
#chord-sheet-root select,#chord-sheet-root input[type=text],#chord-sheet-root textarea,#chord-sheet-root button{
  font-size:.92rem;padding:.45rem .7rem;border-radius:.375rem;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-family:inherit
}
#chord-sheet-root select:focus,#chord-sheet-root input:focus,#chord-sheet-root textarea:focus{
  outline:none;border-color:#86b7e0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--primary-tint)
}
#chord-sheet-root .chords-textarea{width:100%;resize:vertical;min-height:52px;line-height:1.45}
#chord-sheet-root .title-inp{width:220px}
#chord-sheet-root .chord-type-sel{min-width:170px}

/* ===== buttons ===== */
#chord-sheet-root button{cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
#chord-sheet-root .btn.primary{background:var(--primary);border-color:var(--primary);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
#chord-sheet-root .btn.primary:hover{background:var(--primary-dark);border-color:var(--primary-dark)}
#chord-sheet-root .btn.add-btn{background:var(--primary-tint);border-color:var(--primary-tint-border);color:#1c5fa8;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
#chord-sheet-root .btn.add-btn:hover{background:rgba(39,128,227,.16)}
#chord-sheet-root button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
#chord-sheet-root .clear-btn{border:none;background:none;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:.25rem}
#chord-sheet-root .clear-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);background:var(--danger-tint)}

/* ===== root chips ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .add-type{align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
#chord-sheet-root .add-type .panel-sublabel{margin:0}
#chord-sheet-root #inp-root{width:3.2rem;height:2rem;padding:0 .45rem;font-size:.9rem;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:.4rem}
#chord-sheet-root #inp-root.bad{border-color:#c0392b;background:#fdf1ef}
#chord-sheet-root .add-type .chord-type-sel{width:auto;min-width:0;max-width:15rem;height:2rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:0 .4rem}
#chord-sheet-root .add-type .btn{height:2rem;padding:0 .7rem;font-size:.85rem}
#chord-sheet-root .view-sel{gap:.4rem}
#chord-sheet-root .view-sel select{width:auto;height:1.9rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:0 .35rem}
#chord-sheet-root .super-row{margin-top:.5rem}
#chord-sheet-root .super-opt{display:none}
#chord-sheet-root.super-on .super-opt{display:inline-flex}
#chord-sheet-root .super-picks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.5rem;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
#chord-sheet-root .super-picks:empty{display:none}
#chord-sheet-root .super-picks button{border:1px solid var(--border-strong);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .65rem;font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
#chord-sheet-root .super-picks button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
#chord-sheet-root .super-opt-block{display:none}
#chord-sheet-root.super-on .super-opt-block{display:block}
#chord-sheet-root .super-sections{margin-top:.5rem;font-size:.85rem}
#chord-sheet-root .super-sections>summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}
#chord-sheet-root .super-sections textarea{width:100%;margin-top:.4rem;font:inherit;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:.85rem;padding:.4rem .55rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:.4rem;resize:vertical}
#chord-sheet-root .super-section-name{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin:.2rem 0 .35rem}
#chord-sheet-root .super-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:.6rem;padding:.6rem;margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto}
#chord-sheet-root .super-card svg{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
#chord-sheet-root .super-note{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);margin:.35rem 0 0}
#chord-sheet-root .super-lane-label{cursor:pointer}
#chord-sheet-root .extras{margin:1.5rem 0 .5rem;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);text-align:center}
#chord-sheet-root .extras button{background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0 .15rem;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer}
#chord-sheet-root.no-preview .header-bar{display:none}
#chord-sheet-root.few-insts .inst-row.extra-inst{display:none}
#chord-sheet-root .root-chip{border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:.375rem;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-size:.8rem;padding:.4rem .55rem;min-width:2.5rem;text-align:center}
#chord-sheet-root .root-chip.active{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
#chord-sheet-root .root-chip:hover:not(.active){border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-tint)}
#chord-sheet-root .root-chip.dual{font-size:.68rem}

/* ===== chord chips ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .chord-count{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
#chord-sheet-root .chords-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;min-height:20px;margin-top:.5rem}
#chord-sheet-root .chord-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:.25rem .4rem .25rem .65rem;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--primary-tint-border);background:var(--primary-tint);color:#1c5fa8;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
#chord-sheet-root .chord-chip.bad{border-color:var(--danger-tint-border);background:var(--danger-tint);color:#a52834}
#chord-sheet-root .chip-del{border:none;background:none;padding:0 1px;color:inherit;opacity:.55;font-size:.85rem;line-height:1}
#chord-sheet-root .chip-del:hover{opacity:1}

/* ===== checkboxes ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .cb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;align-self:center}
#chord-sheet-root .cb input,#chord-sheet-root .inst-check input{accent-color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-size:.86rem;cursor:pointer}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-check strong{font-weight:600}

/* ===== instruments ===== */
#chord-sheet-root #instrument-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:.5rem;background:#fff;padding:.5rem .65rem;min-width:170px}
#chord-sheet-root .tuning-sel{display:none;font-size:.84rem;padding:.4rem .6rem;border-radius:.375rem;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
#chord-sheet-root .tuning-sel.show{display:block}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-row .tuning-sel{width:100%}
#chord-sheet-root #sel-hand-mode{width:auto;min-width:190px;margin-top:.4rem}

/* ===== preview header ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .header-bar{display:flex;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem}
#chord-sheet-root .header-bar h2{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:.15rem}
#chord-sheet-root .count-note{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* ===== sheet output ===== */
#chord-sheet-root .print-sheet-title{display:none;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:1rem}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-section{margin-bottom:1.25rem}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-section+.inst-section{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:1.1rem}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-heading{margin-bottom:.6rem}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-heading h3{font-size:.97rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
#chord-sheet-root .inst-heading p{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
#chord-sheet-root .chord-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:10px}
#chord-sheet-root .keyboard-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
#chord-sheet-root .keyboard-grid .diagram-card{width:max-content;max-width:100%}
#chord-sheet-root .keyboard-grid .diagram-svg-wrap svg{max-width:100%;height:auto!important}   /* a wide voicing shrinks to a phone screen */
#chord-sheet-root .diagram-card{border-radius:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
#chord-sheet-root .diagram-svg-wrap{padding:6px 6px 0}
#chord-sheet-root .diagram-card svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
#chord-sheet-root .voicing-sel{width:100%;border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:#f8f9fa;color:var(--ink);font-size:.72rem;padding:5px 8px;cursor:pointer;appearance:auto;border-radius:0}
#chord-sheet-root .voicing-sel:focus{outline:none;background:#eef4fb;box-shadow:none}
#chord-sheet-root .diagram-unavail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100px;color:var(--faint);font-size:.78rem;text-align:center;gap:3px;padding:6px}
#chord-sheet-root .notation-wrap{width:0;min-width:100%;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:4px 6px 2px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--faint)}
#chord-sheet-root .notation-wrap svg{color:var(--ink)}
#chord-sheet-root .notation-cap{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);margin:.15rem 0 0;line-height:1.3}
#chord-sheet-root .handoff-note{font-size:.82rem;color:#1c5fa8;background:var(--primary-tint);border:1px solid var(--primary-tint-border);border-radius:.375rem;padding:.4rem .7rem;margin:0 0 1rem}
#chord-sheet-root .empty-state{padding:56px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
#chord-sheet-root .empty-state p{margin-top:6px;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--faint)}

@media(max-width:700px){
  #chord-sheet-root .title-inp{width:100%}
  #chord-sheet-root .chord-type-sel{min-width:0;flex:1}
  #chord-sheet-root .header-bar .row{width:100%}
  #chord-sheet-root .header-bar .row button{flex:1 1 auto}
}

/* ===== PRINT ===== */
@media print{
  @page{size:letter landscape;margin:.45in}
  /* the site around the tool: navbar, page title, floating buttons, footer */
  #quarto-header,#title-block-header,#quarto-sidebar,#quarto-margin-sidebar,#quarto-back-to-top,#establish-tonality-btn,.nav-footer,footer.footer{display:none!important}
  body{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;background:#fff!important}
  #quarto-content,#quarto-document-content,.column-screen{display:block!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:auto!important}
  #chord-sheet-root .card,#chord-sheet-root .header-bar,#chord-sheet-root .extras{display:none!important}
  #chord-sheet-root{padding:0;margin:0;max-width:none}
  #chord-sheet-root .print-sheet-title{display:block!important}
  #chord-sheet-root .inst-section+.inst-section{page-break-before:always;border-top:none;padding-top:0}
  #chord-sheet-root .chord-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}
  #chord-sheet-root .keyboard-grid{gap:8px;zoom:.75}   /* keyboards keep their own width, so every key prints the same size */
  #chord-sheet-root .super-card{overflow:visible;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid;border-color:#bbb}
  #chord-sheet-root .inst-heading{break-after:avoid;page-break-after:avoid}
  #chord-sheet-root .diagram-card{break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid;border-color:#bbb}
  #chord-sheet-root .diagram-svg-wrap{padding:4px 4px 0}
  #chord-sheet-root .voicing-sel{display:none}
  #chord-sheet-root .handoff-note{display:none}
  #chord-sheet-root .notation-wrap{border-top-color:#ccc}
  #chord-sheet-root .diagram-unavail{display:none}
  #chord-sheet-root .inst-heading{margin-bottom:6px}
}
</style>

<div id="chord-sheet-root" class="no-preview few-insts">

  <div class="card">
    <div class="row">
      <div>
        <label for="inp-title">Sheet title</label>
        <input class="title-inp" id="inp-title" type="text" value="Chord Sheet" placeholder="Sheet title">
      </div>
      <div style="min-width:260px">
        <label for="sel-key">Key</label>
        <select class="chord-type-sel" id="sel-key" aria-label="Key"></select>
      </div>
      <span id="key-auto-label" class="chord-count" style="align-self:center"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="head-row">
      <span class="panel-label">Chords</span>
      <div class="row tight">
        <span class="chord-count" id="chord-count">0 chords</span>
        <button class="clear-btn" id="btn-clear-chords">Clear</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <textarea id="chords-textarea" class="chords-textarea" rows="2"
      placeholder="e.g.  Am  C6  F  G7  Dm  Bb7"></textarea>
    <p class="field-hint">Enter or Tab to parse · click × to remove</p>
    <div id="chords-chips" class="chords-chips"></div>

    <hr class="panel-rule">
    <div class="row add-type">
      <span class="panel-sublabel">Add by type</span>
      <input id="inp-root" type="text" maxlength="2" size="2" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" spellcheck="false" placeholder="C" aria-label="Root note, for example C, F# or Bb">
      <select class="chord-type-sel" id="sel-chord-type" aria-label="Chord type"></select>
      <button class="btn add-btn" id="btn-add-chord">+ Add</button>
    </div>

    <hr class="panel-rule">
    <div class="row">
      <div style="flex:1 1 240px">
        <span class="panel-sublabel">Add by Roman numeral</span>
        <input class="chords-textarea" id="inp-roman" type="text" style="resize:none;min-height:0" placeholder="V7  ii  bVII  viio7…">
      </div>
      <button class="btn" id="btn-add-roman">Add</button>
    </div>
    <p id="roman-feedback" class="field-hint"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="head-row">
      <span class="panel-label">Instruments</span>
      <div class="row tight">
        <button class="clear-btn" id="btn-inst-all">All</button>
        <button class="clear-btn" id="btn-inst-none">None</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="instrument-list"></div>

    <hr class="panel-rule">
    <div class="row">
      <label class="cb"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-voice-leading"> Favor voice leading</label>
      <label class="cb"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-fingerings"> Show fingerings</label>
      <label class="cb"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-solfege"> Show solfege labels</label>
      <label class="cb"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-notation"> Show notation</label>
      <label class="cb view-sel">Chord names
        <select id="sel-chord-display" aria-label="Chord names">
          <option value="letters">Letters</option>
          <option value="roman">Roman numerals</option>
          <option value="both">Letters and Roman numerals</option>
        </select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="row super-row">
      <label class="cb"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-super"> Superimposed view: up to four chords on one keyboard or fretboard</label>
      <label class="cb view-sel super-opt">Chord labels
        <select id="sel-super-lane" aria-label="Chord labels in the superimposed view">
          <option value="names">Chord names</option><option value="roman">Roman numerals</option><option value="numbers">Numbers (1, 4, 5, 6)</option></select></label>
      <label class="cb view-sel super-opt">Note labels
        <select id="sel-super-dot" aria-label="Note labels in the superimposed view">
          <option value="fingers">Finger numbers</option><option value="notes">Note names</option><option value="degrees">Chord tones (R, 3, 5)</option><option value="solfege">Solfege</option></select></label>
      <label class="cb super-opt"><input type="checkbox" id="chk-super-only"> Hide the separate chord cards</label>
    </div>
    <div id="super-picks" class="super-picks"></div>
    <details class="super-sections super-opt-block" id="super-sections-box">
      <summary>Sections: several superimposed diagrams at once</summary>
      <textarea id="super-sections" rows="3" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="super-sections-hint"
        placeholder="Verse: C G Am F&#10;Chorus: F C/E G Am"></textarea>
      <p class="field-hint" id="super-sections-hint">One line per section, up to four chords each, with an optional name before a colon. Each section is voice-led on its own from its first chord. A slash sets the lowest note, so <code>C/E</code> is C in first inversion and plain <code>C</code> starts in root position. While this box has anything in it, the diagrams above the cards come from here instead of the chord list.</p>
      <p class="field-hint" id="super-sections-note" role="status"></p>
    </details>
    <select id="sel-hand-mode" class="tuning-sel">
      <option value="right">Piano: Right hand</option>
      <option value="left">Piano: Left hand</option>
      <option value="two-hand">Piano: Two hands</option>
    </select>
    <p class="field-hint">Voice leading auto-picks each chord's voicing to minimize motion from the previous chord; on fretted instruments that means the smallest move for the fretting hand. Fretboard: one finger per fret from the lowest fretted note; a barre is finger 1. Piano two-hand: left hand in red, right in gray; a root-position or drop voicing puts the bass note in the left hand and the rest in the right, a rootless or inverted four-note chord is split two and two. The voice-led triad and two-note styles always do this on one string set: pick a different shape under any chord and the chords after it follow. Drop 2, Drop 3, Rootless, Guide tones and the three-string sets list every inversion or form in the menu under each diagram.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="card header-bar">
    <div>
      <h2>Preview</h2>
      <p id="count-note" class="count-note">Add chords and select instruments to build your sheet</p>
    </div>
    <div class="row tight">
      <button class="btn" id="btn-notation" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="Show or hide each voicing written on a staff under its diagram">Show notation</button>
      <button class="btn add-btn" id="btn-band" title="Open the Backing Track page with this progression and the voicings shown here">Play with the band</button>
      <button class="btn primary" onclick="window.print()">Print / Save PDF</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p id="handoff-note" class="handoff-note" style="display:none"></p>
  <div id="sheet-output"></div>
  <p class="extras" id="extras"><button type="button" id="btn-extra-preview">Show the preview bar (print, play with the band)</button> · <button type="button" id="btn-extra-insts">Show banjo, mandolin and vihuela</button></p>

<script src="/apps/shared/voicings.js?v=4"></script>
<script>
(function(){
'use strict';

// ===== DATA =====
const DATA = {
  rootOptions:[
    {pc:0,label:"C",canonical:"C",aliases:["C"]},
    {pc:1,label:"C♯/D♭",canonical:"Db",aliases:["C#","Db"]},
    {pc:2,label:"D",canonical:"D",aliases:["D"]},
    {pc:3,label:"D♯/E♭",canonical:"Eb",aliases:["D#","Eb"]},
    {pc:4,label:"E",canonical:"E",aliases:["E","Fb"]},
    {pc:5,label:"F",canonical:"F",aliases:["F","E#"]},
    {pc:6,label:"F♯/G♭",canonical:"F#",aliases:["F#","Gb"]},
    {pc:7,label:"G",canonical:"G",aliases:["G"]},
    {pc:8,label:"G♯/A♭",canonical:"Ab",aliases:["G#","Ab"]},
    {pc:9,label:"A",canonical:"A",aliases:["A"]},
    {pc:10,label:"A♯/B♭",canonical:"Bb",aliases:["A#","Bb"]},
    {pc:11,label:"B",canonical:"B",aliases:["B","Cb"]}
  ],
  chordGroups:[
    {id:"common",label:"Common",items:[
      {id:"major",label:"Major",symbol:"",formula:"1 3 5",intervals:[0,4,7]},
      {id:"minor",label:"Minor",symbol:"m",formula:"1 b3 5",intervals:[0,3,7]},
      {id:"5",label:"Power Chord",symbol:"5",formula:"1 5",intervals:[0,7]},
      {id:"sus2",label:"Sus 2",symbol:"sus2",formula:"1 2 5",intervals:[0,2,7]},
      {id:"sus4",label:"Sus 4",symbol:"sus4",formula:"1 4 5",intervals:[0,5,7]},
      {id:"6",label:"Six",symbol:"6",formula:"1 3 5 6",intervals:[0,4,7,9]},
      {id:"m6",label:"Minor 6",symbol:"m6",formula:"1 b3 5 6",intervals:[0,3,7,9]},
      {id:"7",label:"Dominant 7",symbol:"7",formula:"1 3 5 b7",intervals:[0,4,7,10]},
      {id:"maj7",label:"Major 7",symbol:"maj7",formula:"1 3 5 7",intervals:[0,4,7,11]},
      {id:"m7",label:"Minor 7",symbol:"m7",formula:"1 b3 5 b7",intervals:[0,3,7,10]}
    ]},
    {id:"color",label:"Color & Extensions",items:[
      {id:"add9",label:"Add 9",symbol:"add9",formula:"1 3 5 9",intervals:[0,4,7,14]},
      {id:"madd9",label:"Minor Add 9",symbol:"m(add9)",formula:"1 b3 5 9",intervals:[0,3,7,14]},

// ===== MUSIC THEORY =====
const FLAT_NAMES  = ['C','Db','D','Eb','E','F','Gb','G','Ab','A','Bb','B'];
const SHARP_NAMES = ['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B'];
const WHITE_PCS   = new Set([0,2,4,5,7,9,11]);
const LETTERS     = ['C','D','E','F','G','A','B'];
const LETTER_IDX  = {C:0,D:1,E:2,F:3,G:4,A:5,B:6};
const LETTER_PC   = {C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11};

function mod12(n){return((n%12)+12)%12}
function getRootOption(pc){return DATA.rootOptions.find(r=>r.pc===mod12(pc))}
function noteName(pc,useFlats){return useFlats?FLAT_NAMES[mod12(pc)]:SHARP_NAMES[mod12(pc)]}
function accidentalStr(n){return n>0?'#'.repeat(n):n<0?'b'.repeat(-n):''}

function parseNote(str){
  const letter=str.charAt(0);
  if(!LETTER_IDX.hasOwnProperty(letter))return null;
  const acc=str.slice(1).split('').reduce((n,c)=>c==='#'?n+1:c==='b'?n-1:n,0);
  return{letter,accidental:acc,name:letter+accidentalStr(acc),pc:mod12(LETTER_PC[letter]+acc)};
}

function accidentalWeight(n){const t=Math.abs(n);return t<=1?t:t*t+1}

function parseDegree(str){
  const m=/^([b#]*)(\d+)$/.exec(str||'');
  if(!m)return null;
  const acc=m[1].split('').reduce((n,c)=>n+(c==='#'?1:-1),0);
  return{accidental:acc,degree:Number(m[2]),label:str};
}

function spellNotesForItem(rootNote,item,rootPc){
  const formula=item.formula.trim().split(/\s+/);
  const rootLetterIdx=LETTER_IDX[rootNote.letter];
  return item.intervals.map((interval,i)=>{
    const parsed=parseDegree(formula[i]);
    const degree=parsed?parsed.degree:i+1;
    const letter=LETTERS[(rootLetterIdx+degree-1)%LETTERS.length];
    const pc=mod12(rootPc+interval);
    let acc=mod12(pc-LETTER_PC[letter]);
    if(acc>6)acc-=12;
    return{degree:parsed?parsed.label:String(degree),interval,pc,name:letter+accidentalStr(acc),isRoot:mod12(interval)===0,accidental:acc};
  });
}

function uniqueArray(arr){return[...new Set(arr)]}

function bestSpelling(rootPc,item){
  // Key-aware: when a key is set, spell on the line of fifths centered on it.
  if(window.PitchSpelling&&manualKeyPc!=null){
    try{
      const sp=window.PitchSpelling.spellPitchClass(rootPc, window.PitchSpelling.keyTonicLOF(manualKeyPc));
      const pn=parseNote(sp.name.replace(/♯/g,'#').replace(/♭/g,'b'));
      if(pn&&pn.pc===mod12(rootPc)) return pn;
    }catch(e){}
  }
  const opt=getRootOption(rootPc);
  const aliases=uniqueArray((opt&&opt.aliases&&opt.aliases.length?opt.aliases:[noteName(rootPc,false),noteName(rootPc,true)]))
    .map(a=>parseNote(a)).filter(p=>p&&p.pc===mod12(rootPc));
  if(!aliases.length)return parseNote(noteName(rootPc,false));
  return aliases.map(a=>{
    const notes=spellNotesForItem(a,item,rootPc);
    const noteScore=notes.reduce((s,t)=>s+accidentalWeight(t.accidental),0);
    const aliasScore=0.25*accidentalWeight(a.accidental);
    const canonicalScore=0.05*(a.name!==(opt?opt.canonical:'')?1:0);
    return{...a,score:noteScore+aliasScore+canonicalScore};
  }).sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score)[0];
}

function spellItemNotes(rootPc,item){
  return spellNotesForItem(bestSpelling(rootPc,item),item,rootPc).map(({accidental,...rest})=>rest);
}

function noteNamesByPitchClass(rootPc,item){
  return spellItemNotes(rootPc,item).reduce((map,t)=>{
    if(!map[mod12(t.pc)])map[mod12(t.pc)]=t.name;
    return map;
  },{});
}

function isWhiteKey(pc){return WHITE_PCS.has(mod12(pc))}
function previousWhiteMidi(midi){let m=midi;while(!isWhiteKey(m))m--;return m}
function nextWhiteMidi(midi){let m=midi;while(!isWhiteKey(m))m++;return m}
function listWhiteMidis(start,end){const list=[];for(let i=start;i<=end;i++)if(isWhiteKey(i))list.push(i);return list}
function preferFlats(rootPc){const opt=getRootOption(rootPc);return!!(opt&&opt.canonical.includes('b'))}

function getChord(id){
  for(const g of DATA.chordGroups){const item=g.items.find(i=>i.id===id);if(item)return item}
  return null;
}

function chordPitchClasses(rootPc,chord){return uniqueArray(chord.intervals.map(i=>mod12(rootPc+i)))}

function essentialChordPitchClasses(rootPc,chord){
  const list=[];
  function addGroup(pcs){pcs.forEach(pc=>{if(chord.intervals.includes(pc))list.push(pc)})}
  list.push(0);addGroup([2,3,4,5,6,8]);addGroup([9,10,11]);
  chord.intervals.filter(i=>i>11).forEach(i=>list.push(mod12(i)));
  addGroup([7]);
  return uniqueArray(list.map(pc=>mod12(rootPc+pc)));
}

function buildChordMidis(rootPc,chord,inversion=0,octShift=0){
  const base=60+mod12(rootPc)+12*octShift;
  const midis=[...chord.intervals.map(i=>base+i)];
  for(let i=0;i<inversion;i++) if(midis.length) midis.push(midis.shift()+12);
  return midis;
}

function buildChordTones(rootPc,chord,inversion=0,rootNote=null,octShift=0){
  const base=60+mod12(rootPc)+12*octShift;
  const names=rootNote?spellNotesForItem(rootNote,chord,rootPc).map(({accidental,...r})=>r):spellItemNotes(rootPc,chord);
  const tones=[...chord.intervals.map((interval,i)=>({...names[i],midi:base+interval}))];
  for(let i=0;i<inversion;i++) if(tones.length){const t=tones.shift();tones.push({...t,midi:t.midi+12})}
  return tones;
}

function chordDisplayName(rootPc,chord){
  const spelling=bestSpelling(rootPc,chord);
  const name=spelling?spelling.name:noteName(rootPc,false);
  return chord.symbol?name+chord.symbol:name;
}

// ===== KEY CONTEXT & SOLFEGE =====
const MAJOR_PROFILE=[6.35,2.23,3.48,2.33,4.38,4.09,2.52,5.19,2.39,3.66,2.29,2.88];
let manualKeyPc=null;
let showSolfege=false;

function buildPcWeight(){
  const w=new Array(12).fill(0);
  parsedTokens.forEach(t=>{
    if(!t.valid)return;
    const chord=getChord(t.chordId);if(!chord)return;
    chord.intervals.forEach(iv=>{w[mod12(t.rootPc+iv)]+=1;});
  });
  return w;
}

function currentKeyContext(){
  if(manualKeyPc!=null)return{tonicPc:manualKeyPc};
  const w=buildPcWeight();
  const total=w.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0);
  if(total<3)return{tonicPc:0};
  let bestPc=0,bestScore=-Infinity;
  for(let t=0;t<12;t++){
    let score=0;
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++)score+=MAJOR_PROFILE[(i-t+12)%12]*w[i];
    if(score>bestScore){bestScore=score;bestPc=t;}
  }
  return{tonicPc:bestPc};
}

const SOLFEGE=['Do','Ra','Re','Me','Mi','Fa','Se','So','Le','La','Te','Ti'];
function solfegeForPc(pc){
  // DO-based (movable do): syllables are relative to DO (the key signature), so the
  // minor tonic is La, not Do. Falls back to the tool's key context if no shared DO.
  const tonicPc=(window.Tonality&&Tonality.getDo()!=null)?Tonality.getDo():currentKeyContext().tonicPc;
  return SOLFEGE[(((pc-tonicPc)%12)+12)%12];
}
function labelForPc(pc,fallbackName){
  const s=showSolfege?solfegeForPc(mod12(pc)):fallbackName;
  return (s||'').replace(/x/g,'♯♯').replace(/#/g,'♯').replace(/b/g,'♭');
}

// ===== VOICING STYLES & FINGERINGS =====
let showFingerings=false;
let kbHandMode='right';
const EXTRA_INSTS=['banjo','mandolin','vihuela'];   // offered only after "Show banjo, mandolin and vihuela" at the bottom of the page

// Every keyboard style (Standard, Shell, Guide tones, Rootless, Drop 2, Drop 3) and the drop and
// three-string guitar styles come from the shared ChordVoicings library (apps/shared/voicings.js),
// so this tool, the menus and the backing band use the same shapes. Only the fret-position
// search behind the guitar-family "Standard" and "Shell" menu items lives in this file.
const CV=window.ChordVoicings||null;
const PLAYED='played';                                // "As played": notes handed over by the Backing Track
const KB_STYLES=CV?CV.styles('piano'):[{id:'standard',label:'Standard'},{id:'shell',label:'Shell (R-3-7)'}];
const isDropStyle=s=>s==='drop2'||s==='drop3';
// vl:<triadvl|uppervl>:<k> = voice-led triads on the adjacent three-string set k places down from
// the top. These styles always voice-lead: each chord takes the shape whose strings move least
// from the chord before; a shape the user picks by hand is kept and the chords after it follow.
const isLedStyle=s=>!!s&&s.startsWith('vl:');
const isPairStyle=s=>!!s&&s.startsWith('pair:');    // pair:<lo string index> | pair:all = two-note chords on inner string pairs
const isLibStyle=s=>isDropStyle(s)||isLedStyle(s)||isPairStyle(s)||(!!s&&s.startsWith('set3:'));
const isAlwaysLed=s=>isLedStyle(s)||isPairStyle(s);   // styles that always follow the hand from chord to chord
const PAIR_GROUP='Two-note chords — 3rd and 7th';
const LED_GROUP={triadvl:'Voice-led triads — root, 3rd, 5th',uppervl:'Voice-led upper triads — 3rd, 5th, 7th'};
const CV_PROBE=[[0,4,7,10],[0,3,7,10],[0,4,7,11],[0,3,6,10],[0,3,6,9],[0,4,7,9]];   // 7 m7 maj7 m7b5 dim7 6, tried on every root
const SET3_GROUP='Three-string sets — triads, 7ths without the 5th';

// Fretted styles come from the library's guitar list and depend on the tuning: a drop voicing
// is offered only where the tuning can play it, and the three-string styles become one menu
// group (string 1 = highest) with an item per adjacent set plus one that roams every set.
function frettedStyleOptions(tuning){
  const reg=CV?CV.styles('guitar'):[{id:'standard',label:'Standard',sheetOnly:true},{id:'shell',label:'Shell (R-3-7)',sheetOnly:true}];
  const opts=[];
  const open=tuning?tuning.strings.map(s=>s.openMidi):[],n=open.length;
  const playable=style=>CV_PROBE.every(intervals=>{for(let root=0;root<12;root++)if(!CV.guitar({root,intervals},style,{tuning:open}).length)return false;return true});
  reg.forEach(st=>{
    if(st.sheetOnly)opts.push({id:st.id,label:st.label});
    else if(!CV||!tuning)return;
    else if(st.id==='triad3'){
      if(n>3)opts.push({id:'set3:all',label:'Three strings: all sets',group:SET3_GROUP});
      for(let k=0;k+3<=n;k++)opts.push({id:'set3:'+k,label:`Three strings: ${k+3}-${k+2}-${k+1}`,group:SET3_GROUP});
    }
    else if(st.id==='shell3')return;                  // same grips as the set3 items (triads on triads, R-3-7 on 7ths)
    else if(st.id==='guide2'){
      if(n>4)opts.push({id:'pair:all',label:'Two notes: all pairs',group:PAIR_GROUP});
      for(let lo=n-3;lo>=1;lo--)opts.push({id:'pair:'+lo,label:`Two notes: strings ${n-lo-1}-${n-lo}`,group:PAIR_GROUP});
    }
    else if(LED_GROUP[st.id]){
      for(let k=0;k+3<=n;k++)opts.push({id:`vl:${st.id}:${k}`,label:`${st.id==='uppervl'?'Upper triads':'Triads'}, voice-led: strings ${k+3}-${k+2}-${k+1}`,group:LED_GROUP[st.id]});
    }
    else if(playable(st.id))opts.push({id:st.id,label:st.label});
  });
  return opts;
}

function applyVoicingStyle(chord,style){
  if(style!=='shell')return chord;
  const hasSeventh=chord.intervals.some(i=>mod12(i)===10||mod12(i)===11);
  if(!hasSeventh)return chord;
  const formula=chord.formula.split(/\s+/);
  const keep=formula.map(f=>{
    const d=parseDegree(f);
    return !(d&&d.degree===5&&d.accidental===0);
  });
  return{
    ...chord,
    intervals:chord.intervals.filter((_,i)=>keep[i]),
    formula:formula.filter((_,i)=>keep[i]).join(' ')
  };
}

// A set of sounding notes [{string,fret,midi}] → the position object the diagram code draws
// (unused strings muted). A shape wider than five frets gets a taller diagram.
function positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,list,label){
  const strings=tuning.strings.map(()=>({fret:null,muted:true}));
  list.forEach(s=>{const pc=mod12(s.midi);strings[s.string]={fret:s.fret,pc,midi:s.midi,isRoot:pc===mod12(rootPc)}});
  const frets=list.map(s=>s.fret),top=Math.max(...frets);
  const startFret=top<=4||frets.includes(0)?0:Math.min(...frets);
  return{startFret,fretCount:Math.max(5,startFret===0?top:top-startFret+1),strings,barres:findBarres(strings),label};
}

// Library shapes → positions. set3:<k> = the adjacent three-string set k places down from the
// top; set3:all = every set.
function libraryPositions(tuning,rootPc,chord,styleId){
  const n=tuning.strings.length,opts={tuning:tuning.strings.map(s=>s.openMidi)};
  let style=styleId;
  if(styleId.startsWith('set3:')){
    style='shell3';                                  // close triads for triads, R-3-7 for 7th chords
    const k=styleId.slice(5);
    if(k!=='all'){const lo=n-3-Number(k);if(lo<0)return[];opts.stringSets=[[lo,lo+1,lo+2]];}
  }
  if(isPairStyle(styleId)){
    const k=styleId.slice(5);
    if(k!=='all')opts.stringSets=[[Number(k),Number(k)+1]];
    opts.allPositions=true;opts.maxFret=12;
    return CV.guitar({root:rootPc,intervals:chord.intervals},'guide2',opts).map(v=>positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,v.strings,v.label+' · fret '+Math.min(...v.strings.map(x=>x.fret))));
  }
  if(isLedStyle(styleId)){
    const parts=styleId.split(':'),lo=n-3-Number(parts[2]);
    if(lo<0)return[];
    style=parts[1];opts.stringSets=[[lo,lo+1,lo+2]];opts.allPositions=true;opts.maxFret=12;
    return CV.guitar({root:rootPc,intervals:chord.intervals},style,opts)
      .sort((a,b)=>a.midis[0]-b.midis[0])
      .map(v=>positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,v.strings,v.order+' · fret '+Math.min(...v.strings.map(x=>x.fret))));
  }
  return CV.guitar({root:rootPc,intervals:chord.intervals},style,opts).map(v=>positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,v.strings,v.label));
}

// "As played" on a fretted instrument: the library shape whose sounding notes are exactly
// `midis`; failing that, the notes on the lowest playable frets (one note per string).
function playedPosition(tuning,rootPc,chord,midis,grip){
  const open=tuning.strings.map(s=>s.openMidi),want=midis.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b),key=want.join();
  // the grip the band chose, when it was handed over and fits this tuning
  if(grip&&grip.length===want.length&&grip.every(g=>open[g.string]!=null&&open[g.string]+g.fret===g.midi)&&grip.map(g=>g.midi).sort((a,b)=>a-b).join()===key)
    return positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,grip.map(g=>({string:g.string,fret:g.fret,midi:g.midi})),'As played');
  if(CV){                                              // else the library shape with these notes that sits lowest on the neck
    let best=null;
    for(const style of['drop2','drop3','triad3','shell3','triadvl','uppervl','guide2'])
      CV.guitar({root:rootPc,intervals:chord.intervals},style,{tuning:open,allPositions:true,maxFret:19,maxSpan:5}).forEach(v=>{
        if(v.midis.join()!==key)return;
        const top=Math.max(...v.strings.map(x=>x.fret));
        if(!best||top<best.top)best={top,v};
      });
    if(best)return positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,best.v.strings,'As played');
  }
  let best=null;
  const cur=[],usedStr=new Set();
  (function place(i){
    if(i===want.length){
      const frets=cur.map(c=>c.fret),fretted=frets.filter(f=>f>0),span=fretted.length?Math.max(...fretted)-Math.min(...fretted):0;
      const cost=(span>4?1e4:0)+Math.max(...frets)*100+frets.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
      if(!best||cost<best.cost)best={cost,list:cur.map(c=>({...c}))};
      return;
    }
    for(let st=0;st<open.length;st++){
      const fret=want[i]-open[st];
      if(usedStr.has(st)||fret<0||fret>19)continue;
      usedStr.add(st);cur.push({string:st,fret,midi:want[i]});place(i+1);cur.pop();usedStr.delete(st);
    }
  })(0);
  return best?positionFromStrings(tuning,rootPc,best.list,'As played'):null;
}

// Fretted positions for a chord token in a style (cached per tuning + style).
function getPositions(t,tuning,baseChord,styleId){
  if(styleId===PLAYED&&!t.played)styleId='standard';  // a chord added after the import has nothing handed over
  const cacheKey=tuning.id+':'+styleId;
  if(!t.positionCache[cacheKey]){
    if(styleId===PLAYED){const p=playedPosition(tuning,t.rootPc,baseChord,t.played.midis,t.played.strings);t.positionCache[cacheKey]=p?[p]:[]}
    else if(CV&&isLibStyle(styleId))t.positionCache[cacheKey]=libraryPositions(tuning,t.rootPc,baseChord,styleId);
    else{
      const chord=applyVoicingStyle(baseChord,styleId);
      t.positionCache[cacheKey]=generateChordPositions(
        tuning,chordPitchClasses(t.rootPc,chord),
        essentialChordPitchClasses(t.rootPc,chord),t.rootPc,chord
      );
    }
  }
  return t.positionCache[cacheKey];
}

// Keyboard voicings by style, one candidate per inversion / form: all from the library.
// Rootless and Guide tones keep to their own register (the library's default).
function kbCandidates(rootPc,chord,styleId){
  if(!CV||styleId===PLAYED)return[];
  return CV.piano({root:rootPc,intervals:chord.intervals},styleId,isDropStyle(styleId)?{lo:36,hi:96,center:60}:{});
}
function kbInvCount(rootPc,chord,styleId){return kbCandidates(rootPc,chord,styleId).length||chord.intervals.length}
function kbMidis(rootPc,chord,styleId,inv,oct){
  const c=kbCandidates(rootPc,chord,styleId);
  if(!c.length)return buildChordMidis(rootPc,chord,inv,oct);
  return c[Math.min(inv,c.length-1)].midis.map(m=>m+12*(oct||0));
}
// Octave shifts voice leading may use: the jazz styles stay in their written register.
function kbOctOk(styleId,midis){return(styleId!=='rootless'&&styleId!=='guide')||(Math.min(...midis)>=48&&Math.max(...midis)<=77)}

// A note's name from its degree in the chord (so a rootless 9th or 13th is spelled from the root).
function spellDegree(rootNote,deg,midi){
  const m=/^([b#]*)(\d+)$/.exec(deg||''),d=deg==='R'?1:m?Number(m[2]):0;
  if(!d||!rootNote)return null;
  const letter=LETTERS[(LETTER_IDX[rootNote.letter]+d-1)%7];
  let acc=mod12(midi-LETTER_PC[letter]);if(acc>6)acc-=12;
  return letter+accidentalStr(acc);
}
// Tones ({name,pc,midi,isRoot}) for a list of midis: names from the chord's spelling, anything
// outside the chord (a rootless 9th, an "as played" extension) from its degree or a plain name.
function toneNames(rootPc,chord,rootNote,midis,degrees){
  const names=rootNote?spellNotesForItem(rootNote,chord,rootPc).map(({accidental,...r})=>r):spellItemNotes(rootPc,chord);
  return midis.map((m,i)=>{
    const hit=names.find(x=>mod12(x.pc)===mod12(m));
    if(hit)return{...hit,midi:m};
    const nm=degrees&&spellDegree(rootNote||bestSpelling(rootPc,chord),degrees[i],m);
    return{...(nm?{name:nm}:{}),pc:mod12(m),midi:m,isRoot:mod12(m)===mod12(rootPc)};
  });
}
function kbTones(rootPc,chord,styleId,inv,rootNote,oct){
  const cands=kbCandidates(rootPc,chord,styleId);
  if(!cands.length)return buildChordTones(rootPc,chord,inv,rootNote,oct);
  const c=cands[Math.min(inv,cands.length-1)];
  return toneNames(rootPc,chord,rootNote,c.midis.map(m=>m+12*(oct||0)),c.tones);
}

// Fretting-hand fingers, one per string (null = open or unplayed). One finger per fret from the
// lowest fretted note, squeezed so every note gets a finger: a note never takes a lower finger than
// one on a lower fret, notes on one fret go low string first, and the last notes still fit under
// finger 4. A barre (the diagram's own, or two or more ADJACENT strings on the lowest fret with
// higher notes above) is finger 1.
function computeFretboardFingerings(position){
  const result=position.strings.map(()=>null);
  const fretted=position.strings.map((s,i)=>({s,i})).filter(x=>x.s&&x.s.fret>0);
  if(!fretted.length)return result;
  const minF=Math.min(...fretted.map(x=>x.s.fret));
  const mainBarre=(position.barres||[]).find(b=>b.type==='main');
  let barre=[];
  if(mainBarre)barre=fretted.filter(x=>x.i>=mainBarre.startString&&x.i<=mainBarre.endString&&x.s.fret===mainBarre.fret);
  else{
    const low=fretted.filter(x=>x.s.fret===minF);
    const adjacent=low.length>=2&&low.every((x,k)=>k===0||x.i===low[k-1].i+1);
    if(adjacent&&fretted.length>low.length&&fretted.length>3)barre=low;
  }
  barre.forEach(x=>{result[x.i]=1});
  const rest=fretted.filter(x=>result[x.i]===null).sort((a,b)=>a.s.fret-b.s.fret||a.i-b.i);
  let prev=barre.length?1:0,prevFret=-1;
  rest.forEach((x,k)=>{
    const base=Math.min(4,x.s.fret-minF+1),after=rest.length-1-k;
    let f=Math.max(base,prev+1);
    if(f>4-after)f=Math.max(4-after,x.s.fret===prevFret?prev:prev+1);   // out of fingers: a small barre on one fret
    f=Math.max(1,Math.min(4,f));
    result[x.i]=f;prev=f;prevFret=x.s.fret;
  });
  return result;
}

// ---- piano ----
// Finger pairs: [ideal span, widest comfortable span] in semitones, right hand low to high.
const FINGER_SPAN={'12':[4,8],'13':[4.5,9],'14':[7,10],'15':[8,12],'23':[3,4],'24':[5,6],'25':[6,9],'34':[2,3],'35':[4,6],'45':[2,4]};
// Best right-hand fingers for ascending notes: every increasing set of fingers is scored by how far
// each neighbouring pair is from its natural span (a stretch past the comfortable limit costs most).
function handFingers(midis){
  const n=midis.length;
  if(n===0)return[];if(n===1)return[1];if(n>=5)return midis.map((_,i)=>Math.min(i+1,5));
  if(n===2){const gap=midis[1]-midis[0];return[1,gap<=2?2:gap<=4?3:gap<=6?4:5]}        // a second 1-2, a third 1-3, a fourth 1-4, wider 1-5
  let best=null,bestCost=Infinity;
  (function rec(start,seq){
    if(seq.length===n){
      let cost=0;
      for(let k=1;k<n;k++){const sp=FINGER_SPAN[''+seq[k-1]+seq[k]],gap=midis[k]-midis[k-1];cost+=Math.abs(gap-sp[0])+(gap>sp[1]?3*(gap-sp[1]):0)}
      const span=midis[n-1]-midis[0];
      if(seq[0]!==1)cost+=n>=3?3:1;if(span>=5&&seq[n-1]!==5)cost+=3;       // chords sit between thumb and little finger
      if(cost<bestCost-1e-9){bestCost=cost;best=seq.slice()}
      return;
    }
    for(let f=start;f<=5-(n-seq.length-1);f++){seq.push(f);rec(f+1,seq);seq.pop()}
  })(1,[]);
  return best;
}
// The left hand is the right hand's mirror image.
function leftFingers(midis){
  if(midis.length===1)return[5];                       // a lone bass note goes to the little finger
  const top=midis[midis.length-1],mirrored=midis.map(m=>top-m).reverse();
  return handFingers(mirrored).reverse();
}
// How two hands share a chord (notes ascending) -> how many go to the left hand.
//   root position, or a bass note well below the rest (drop 2, drop 3): the left hand takes the bass
//   alone and the right hand the upper notes;  a rootless or inverted four-note chord: two and two;
//   five or more notes: two in the left hand, or wherever the widest gap falls.
function leftHandCount(midis,rootPc){
  const n=midis.length;
  if(n<=1)return 0;if(n<=3)return 1;
  const gaps=midis.slice(1).map((m,i)=>m-midis[i]),rootBass=rootPc!=null&&mod12(midis[0])===mod12(rootPc);
  if(n===4)return(rootBass||gaps[0]>=7)?1:2;
  let k=1;for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++)if(gaps[i]>gaps[k-1]+1e-9&&i+1<=3&&n-(i+1)<=5)k=i+1;
  return Math.max(n-5,Math.min(k,gaps[0]>=7?1:Math.max(2,k)));
}
function computeKeyboardFingerings(tones,mode,rootPc){
  mode=mode||'right';
  const sorted=[...tones].sort((a,b)=>a.midi-b.midi),midis=sorted.map(t=>t.midi),result=new Map();
  if(mode==='right')handFingers(midis).forEach((f,i)=>result.set(midis[i],{finger:f,hand:'R'}));
  else if(mode==='left')leftFingers(midis).forEach((f,i)=>result.set(midis[i],{finger:f,hand:'L'}));
  else{
    const nL=leftHandCount(midis,rootPc),lh=midis.slice(0,nL),rh=midis.slice(nL);
    leftFingers(lh).forEach((f,i)=>result.set(lh[i],{finger:f,hand:'L'}));
    handFingers(rh).forEach((f,i)=>result.set(rh[i],{finger:f,hand:'R'}));
  }
  return result;
}

// ===== VOICE LEADING =====
let favorVoiceLeading=false;

function positionMidis(pos){
  return pos.strings.filter(s=>s&&s.fret!==null&&s.midi!=null).map(s=>s.midi);
}

// Sum of nearest-neighbor semitone distances (asymmetric — penalize uncovered prev notes lightly)
function voiceLeadingDistance(prev,curr){
  if(!prev||!prev.length||!curr.length)return 0;
  let total=0;
  for(const m of curr){
    let min=Infinity;
    for(const p of prev){const d=Math.abs(m-p);if(d<min)min=d;}
    total+=min;
  }
  for(const p of prev){
    let min=Infinity;
    for(const m of curr){const d=Math.abs(p-m);if(d<min)min=d;}
    total+=0.5*min;
  }
  return total;
}

function applyVoiceLeadingForInstrument(inst,tuning){
  const isKeyboard=inst.type==='keyboard';
  const styleId=(S.instruments.get(inst.id).voicingStyle)||'standard';
  const valid=parsedTokens.filter(t=>t.valid);
  if(valid.length<2)return;
  let prev=null,prevGrip=null;
  valid.forEach(t=>{
    const baseChord=getChord(t.chordId);if(!baseChord)return;
    if(styleId===PLAYED&&t.played){prev=t.played.midis;prevGrip=t.played.strings||null;t.voicings[inst.id]=0;return}   // handed over, not chosen
    const chord=isKeyboard?baseChord:applyVoicingStyle(baseChord,styleId);   // keyboard styles shape the full chord themselves
    if(isKeyboard){
      const effStyle=styleId===PLAYED?'standard':styleId;
      const maxInv=Math.max(0,kbInvCount(t.rootPc,chord,effStyle)-1);
      let bestInv=0,bestOct=0;
      if(prev){
        let bestScore=Infinity;
        for(let inv=0;inv<=maxInv;inv++){
          for(let oct=-2;oct<=2;oct++){
            const midis=kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,effStyle,inv,oct);
            if(!kbOctOk(effStyle,midis))continue;
            const score=voiceLeadingDistance(prev,midis);
            if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;bestInv=inv;bestOct=oct;}
          }
        }
      }
      t.voicings[inst.id]=bestInv;
      if(!t.octShifts)t.octShifts={};
      t.octShifts[inst.id]=bestOct;
      prev=kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,effStyle,bestInv,bestOct);
    }else if(tuning){
      // Fretted: the next shape is the smallest move for the fretting HAND from the last one (frets the
      // hand shifts, fingers that move, strings picked up or dropped); the pitches only break near-ties.
      const positions=getPositions(t,tuning,baseChord,styleId);
      if(!positions.length)return;
      const cands=positions.map((pos,i)=>({i,midis:positionMidis(pos),strings:pos.strings.map((x,k)=>x&&x.fret!==null?{string:k,fret:x.fret}:null).filter(Boolean)}));
      const always=isAlwaysLed(styleId);
      const kept=always&&t.ledPick&&t.ledPick[inst.id]!=null?Math.min(t.ledPick[inst.id],positions.length-1):null;
      let idx=0;
      if(kept!=null)idx=kept;
      else if(prevGrip&&CV)idx=CV.easiest(cands,prevGrip,prev,5).i;
      else if(prev){let bs=Infinity;cands.forEach(c=>{const sc=voiceLeadingDistance(prev,c.midis);if(sc<bs){bs=sc;idx=c.i}})}
      else if(always&&CV)idx=CV.easiest(cands,null,null,5).i;            // first chord: around the fifth fret
      t.voicings[inst.id]=idx;
      prev=cands[idx].midis;prevGrip=cands[idx].strings;
    }
  });
}

function applyAllVoiceLeading(){
  DATA.instruments.forEach(inst=>{
    const ist=S.instruments.get(inst.id);
    if(!ist.enabled)return;
    if(!favorVoiceLeading&&!isAlwaysLed(ist.voicingStyle))return;
    const tuning=inst.type==='keyboard'?null:(inst.tunings.find(t=>t.id===ist.tuningId)||inst.tunings[0]||null);
    applyVoiceLeadingForInstrument(inst,tuning);
  });
}

// ===== ROMAN NUMERAL ENTRY =====
function parseRomanNumeral(str){
  str=(str||'').trim();
  let acc=0;
  if(str[0]==='b'){acc=-1;str=str.slice(1);}
  else if(str[0]==='#'){acc=1;str=str.slice(1);}
  const isUpper=str[0]>='A'&&str[0]<='Z';
  const ROMAN_VALS=[['vii',7],['vi',6],['iv',4],['v',5],['iii',3],['ii',2],['i',1]];
  let deg=0,numLen=0;
  const strLow=str.toLowerCase();
  for(const[r,d]of ROMAN_VALS){if(strLow.startsWith(r)){deg=d;numLen=r.length;break;}}
  if(!deg)return null;
  const suffix=str.slice(numLen);
  const DEGREE_SEMIS=[0,0,2,4,5,7,9,11];
  const rootPc=(((currentKeyContext().tonicPc+DEGREE_SEMIS[deg]+acc)%12)+12)%12;
  const sfxLow=suffix.toLowerCase();
  let chordId;
  if(suffix==='M7'||sfxLow==='maj7')chordId='maj7';
  else if(sfxLow==='m7'||sfxLow==='min7')chordId='m7';
  else if(sfxLow==='o7'||sfxLow==='dim7')chordId='dim7';
  else if(sfxLow==='ø7'||sfxLow==='h7'||sfxLow==='m7b5')chordId='m7b5';
  else if(sfxLow==='o'||sfxLow==='dim')chordId='dim';
  else if(sfxLow==='+7'||sfxLow==='aug7')chordId='aug7';
  else if(sfxLow==='+'||sfxLow==='aug')chordId='aug';
  else if(sfxLow==='sus4')chordId='sus4';
  else if(sfxLow==='sus2')chordId='sus2';
  else if(sfxLow==='7sus4')chordId='7sus4';
  else if(sfxLow==='7b9')chordId='7b9';
  else if(sfxLow==='7#9')chordId='7#9';
  else if(sfxLow==='7')chordId=isUpper?'7':'m7';
  else if(sfxLow==='9')chordId=isUpper?'9':'m9';
  else if(sfxLow==='6')chordId=isUpper?'6':'m6';
  else if(sfxLow==='')chordId=isUpper?'major':'minor';
  else return null;
  const rootName=noteName(rootPc,preferFlats(rootPc));
  return{rootPc,chordId,rootName};
}

function addRomanChord(){
  const input=document.getElementById('inp-roman');
  const feedback=document.getElementById('roman-feedback');
  if(!input)return;
  const tokens=input.value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if(!tokens.length)return;
  const failed=[];
  tokens.forEach(tok=>{
    const parsed=parseRomanNumeral(tok);
    if(!parsed){failed.push(tok);return;}
    appendToken(parsed.rootPc,parsed.chordId,parsed.rootName);
  });
  if(feedback)feedback.textContent=failed.length?'Could not parse: '+failed.join(', '):'';
  if(!failed.length)input.value='';
}

// ===== FRETBOARD LOGIC =====
function findBarres(strings){
  const fretted=strings.map((e,i)=>({entry:e,idx:i})).filter(x=>x.entry&&x.entry.fret!==null&&x.entry.fret>0);
  if(!fretted.length)return[];
  const barres=[];
  const minFret=Math.min(...fretted.map(x=>x.entry.fret));
  const firstIdx=strings.findIndex(s=>s&&s.fret===minFret);
  let lastIdx=-1;
  for(let i=strings.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(strings[i]&&strings[i].fret===minFret){lastIdx=i;break}}
  if(firstIdx!==-1&&lastIdx>firstIdx){
    let ok=true;
    for(let i=firstIdx;i<=lastIdx;i++){const s=strings[i];if(!s||s.fret===null||s.fret<minFret){ok=false;break}}
    if(ok)barres.push({fret:minFret,startString:firstIdx,endString:lastIdx,type:'main'});
  }
  uniqueArray(fretted.map(x=>x.entry.fret)).sort((a,b)=>a-b).forEach(fret=>{
    if(fret===minFret)return;
    const indices=fretted.filter(x=>x.entry.fret===fret).map(x=>x.idx).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    let start=-1,prev=-2;
    indices.forEach((idx,i)=>{
      if(start===-1)start=idx;else if(idx!==prev+1){if(prev-start+1>=3)barres.push({fret,startString:start,endString:prev,type:'partial'});start=idx}
      prev=idx;
      if(i===indices.length-1&&prev-start+1>=3)barres.push({fret,startString:start,endString:prev,type:'partial'});
    });
  });
  return barres;
}

function isGuitarStandardOpenChord(tuning,rootPc,chord){
  if(!tuning||tuning.id!=='guitar-standard'||!chord)return false;
  const openRoots={major:[0,2,4,7,9],minor:[2,4,9],'7':[0,2,4,7,9],maj7:[0,4,7,9],m7:[2,4,9],sus2:[0,2,4,7,9],sus4:[0,2,4,7,9],add9:[0,2,7,9]}[chord.id];
  return!!(openRoots&&openRoots.includes(mod12(rootPc)));
}

function generateChordPositions(tuning,allPcs,essentialPcs,rootPc,chordItem){
  const results=[];const seen=new Set();
  for(let startFret=0;startFret<=12;startFret++){
    const pos=findBestPositionAtFret(startFret,tuning,allPcs,essentialPcs,rootPc,chordItem);
    if(pos){const key=pos.strings.map(s=>s.fret===null?'x':s.fret).join('-');if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);results.push(pos)}
  }
  return results;
}

function findBestPositionAtFret(startFret,tuning,allPcs,essentialPcs,rootPc,chordItem){
  const maxFret=startFret===0?4:startFret+4;
  const choices=tuning.strings.map(str=>{
    const opts=[{fret:null,muted:true}];
    for(let f=0;f<=maxFret;f++){
      if(startFret!==0&&f<startFret)continue;
      const pc=mod12(str.openMidi+f);
      if(allPcs.includes(pc))opts.push({fret:f,pc,midi:str.openMidi+f,isRoot:pc===rootPc});
    }
    return opts;
  });
  let best=null;const current=[];
  function search(strIdx){
    if(strIdx===choices.length){
      const score=scorePosition(current,startFret,essentialPcs,rootPc,tuning,chordItem);
      if(score===-Infinity)return;
      if(!best||score>best.score)best={startFret,fretCount:5,strings:current.map(s=>s?{...s}:{fret:null,muted:true}),barres:findBarres(current),score};
      return;
    }
    for(const opt of choices[strIdx]){current.push(opt);search(strIdx+1);current.pop()}
  }
  search(0);return best;
}

function scorePosition(strings,startFret,essentialPcs,rootPc,tuning,chordItem){
  const fretted=strings.filter(s=>s&&s.fret!==null);
  const mutedCount=strings.length-fretted.length;
  const pcs=uniqueArray(fretted.map(s=>s.pc));
  const aboveOpen=fretted.filter(s=>s.fret>0);
  const openCount=fretted.filter(s=>s.fret===0).length;
  const lowestFretted=fretted[0]||null;
  let firstIdx=strings.findIndex(s=>s&&s.fret!==null);let lastIdx=-1;
  for(let i=strings.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(strings[i]&&strings[i].fret!==null){lastIdx=i;break}}
  const gapCount=(firstIdx===-1||lastIdx===-1)?0:strings.slice(firstIdx,lastIdx+1).filter(s=>!s||s.fret===null).length;
  const fretNums=aboveOpen.map(s=>s.fret);
  const uniqueFrets=uniqueArray(fretNums);
  const maxFret=fretNums.length?Math.max(...fretNums):0;
  const minFret=fretNums.length?Math.min(...fretNums):0;
  const fretSpan=aboveOpen.length?maxFret-minFret:0;
  const barres=findBarres(strings);
  const mainBarre=barres.find(b=>b.type==='main')||null;
  const partialBarres=barres.filter(b=>b.type==='partial');
  if(fretted.length<Math.min(3,essentialPcs.length))return -Infinity;
  if(pcs.length<Math.min(3,essentialPcs.length))return -Infinity;
  if(!fretted.some(s=>s.isRoot))return -Infinity;
  if(!essentialPcs.every(pc=>pcs.includes(pc)))return -Infinity;
  if(fretSpan>4)return -Infinity;
  let score=12*pcs.length+3*fretted.length+2.5*essentialPcs.length+openCount*(startFret===0?3.5:0.5)-1.5*mutedCount-6*gapCount-3*startFret;
  if(lowestFretted&&lowestFretted.isRoot)score+=8;else if(lowestFretted)score-=16;
  if(fretted.some(s=>s.fret===0))score+=2;
  if(fretted.some(s=>s.pc===mod12(rootPc+4))||fretted.some(s=>s.pc===mod12(rootPc+3)))score+=1.5;
  if(isGuitarStandardOpenChord(tuning,rootPc,chordItem)&&startFret===0&&openCount>0&&maxFret<=3)score+=24;
  if(openCount>0&&maxFret>3)score-=16;
  if(openCount>0&&uniqueFrets.length>=3)score-=10;
  if(openCount>0&&maxFret>0&&maxFret-minFret>=3)score-=4;
  if(mainBarre){score+=6+(mainBarre.endString-mainBarre.startString+1)*1.4;if(openCount===0)score+=4}
  if(partialBarres.length)score+=partialBarres.reduce((s,b)=>s+(b.endString-b.startString+1)*0.6,0);
  if(openCount===0&&lowestFretted&&lowestFretted.isRoot&&firstIdx>=0&&firstIdx<=1)score+=4;
  if(openCount===0&&uniqueFrets.length<=3)score+=2;
  return score;
}

// ===== SVG RENDERING =====
const SVG_NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
const COLORS={page:'#ffffff',line:'#333333',softLine:'#000000',border:'#b3b3b3',active:'#ffffff',root:'#2b2b2b',rootText:'#ffffff',blackKey:'#1a1a1a',label:'#1f1f1f',board:'#ffffff'};
const EXCL_COLORS={fill:'#ececec',stroke:'#bcbcbc',text:'#a8a8a8'};   // note excluded from the voicing

function createSvg(w,h){
  const svg=document.createElementNS(SVG_NS,'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('width','100%');svg.setAttribute('height','100%');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${w} ${h}`);
  svg.setAttribute('role','img');svg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio','xMidYMid meet');
  return svg;
}
function svgEl(tag,attrs){
  const el=document.createElementNS(SVG_NS,tag);
  Object.entries(attrs||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>el.setAttribute(k,String(v)));
  return el;
}
function svgText(parent,text,x,y,opts){
  const attrs={x,y,'font-size':opts['font-size']||12,'font-weight':opts['font-weight']||600,fill:opts.fill||COLORS.label,'text-anchor':opts['text-anchor']||'middle','font-family':opts['font-family']||'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif'};
  ['dominant-baseline','letter-spacing','lengthAdjust','textLength','class','data-pc','style'].forEach(k=>{if(opts[k]!==undefined)attrs[k]=opts[k]});
  const el=svgEl('text',attrs);el.textContent=text;parent.appendChild(el);return el;
}
function svgNoteLabel(parent,text,x,y,opts){
  const multi=text.length>1;
  // No textLength/lengthAdjust: glyphs keep their natural width (the capital letter
  // matches single-note labels); a small negative letter-spacing tucks the accidental.
  return svgText(parent,text,x,y,{...opts,'dominant-baseline':'middle','font-weight':opts['font-weight']||500,'letter-spacing':multi?'-0.5':'0'});
}
// big: the fretboard diagrams, where the chord symbol is as large as the fret label
function svgDiagramTitle(parent,title,width,big){
  parent.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:0,y:0,width:width,height:40,fill:'transparent','class':'diagram-title',style:'cursor:pointer'}));
  const size=big?(title.length>16?17:title.length>11?22:27):(title.length>16?12.5:title.length>12?14:15.5);
  svgText(parent,title,width/2,big?31:23,{'font-size':size,'font-weight':700,fill:COLORS.label,'class':'diagram-title',style:'cursor:pointer'});
}
function svgBackground(parent,w,h){parent.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:0,y:0,width:w,height:h,fill:COLORS.page}))}
function markerColors(isRoot){return isRoot?{fill:COLORS.root,stroke:COLORS.line,text:COLORS.rootText}:{fill:COLORS.active,stroke:COLORS.line,text:COLORS.label}}

const BARRE_START_PCS=new Set([0,5]);
const BARRE_END_PCS=new Set([4,11]);

function selectKeyboardRange(midis){
  const lo=Math.min(...midis),hi=Math.max(...midis);
  const startBase=previousWhiteMidi(lo),endBase=nextWhiteMidi(hi);
  const candidates=[];
  for(let s=previousWhiteMidi(startBase);s>=startBase-24;s--){
    if(!isWhiteKey(s)||!BARRE_START_PCS.has(mod12(s)))continue;
    for(let e=nextWhiteMidi(endBase);e<=endBase+24;e++){
      if(!isWhiteKey(e)||!BARRE_END_PCS.has(mod12(e)))continue;
      const whites=listWhiteMidis(s,e);
      if(whites.length<7)continue;
      if(![0,2,4,5,7,9,11].every(pc=>whites.some(m=>mod12(m)===pc)))continue;
      candidates.push({startMidi:s,endMidi:e,whites,score:100*whites.length+Math.abs((s+e)/2-(lo+hi)/2)});
    }
  }
  if(candidates.length)return candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score)[0];
  let s=startBase,e=endBase;let whites=listWhiteMidis(s,e);
  while(whites.length<7){s=previousWhiteMidi(s-1);whites=listWhiteMidis(s,e);if(whites.length<7){e=nextWhiteMidi(e+1);whites=listWhiteMidis(s,e)}}
  return{startMidi:s,endMidi:e,whites};
}

function renderKeyboard({midis,tones,rootPc,useFlats,title,fingerings,excluded}){
  const nameMap=new Map((tones||[]).map(t=>[t.midi,t.name]));
  const activeSet=new Set(midis);
  const{startMidi,endMidi,whites}=selectKeyboardRange(midis);
  const w=42*whites.length+16;
  const svg=createSvg(w,208);
  svg.style.width=w+'px';svg.style.height='208px';
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('title')).textContent=title;
  svgBackground(svg,w,208);
  svgDiagramTitle(svg,title,w);
  const whitePositions=new Map();
  whites.forEach((midi,idx)=>{
    const x=8+42*idx;whitePositions.set(midi,x);
    const active=activeSet.has(midi);
    const tone=(tones||[]).find(t=>t.midi===midi);
    const isRoot=tone?tone.isRoot:false;
    const isExcl=excluded&&excluded.has(mod12(midi));
    const colors=isExcl?EXCL_COLORS:markerColors(isRoot);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x,y:44,width:42,height:146,fill:COLORS.page,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.2}));
    if(active){
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:x+21,cy:176,r:11,fill:colors.fill,stroke:colors.stroke,'stroke-width':1.2,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(midi),style:'cursor:pointer'}));
      svgNoteLabel(svg,labelForPc(mod12(midi),nameMap.get(midi)||noteName(midi,useFlats)),x+21,176.5,{'font-size':13,maxTextLength:17,fill:colors.text,'font-weight':isRoot&&!isExcl?700:500,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(midi),style:'cursor:pointer'});
      if(fingerings&&fingerings.has(midi)){
        const fi=fingerings.get(midi);
        svgText(svg,String(fi.finger),x+21,156,{'font-size':11,'font-weight':700,fill:fi.hand==='L'?'#c0392b':'#444'});
      }
    }
  });
  for(let midi=startMidi;midi<=endMidi;midi++){
    if(isWhiteKey(midi))continue;
    const lo=previousWhiteMidi(midi-1),hi=nextWhiteMidi(midi+1);
    const xLo=whitePositions.get(lo);
    if(xLo===undefined||!whitePositions.has(hi))continue;
    const bx=xLo+42-13;
    const active=activeSet.has(midi);
    const tone=(tones||[]).find(t=>t.midi===midi);
    const isRoot=tone?tone.isRoot:false;
    const isExcl=excluded&&excluded.has(mod12(midi));
    const colors=isExcl?EXCL_COLORS:markerColors(isRoot);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:bx,y:44,width:26,height:84,fill:COLORS.blackKey,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.2}));
    if(active){
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:bx+13,cy:109,r:8.5,fill:colors.fill,stroke:colors.stroke,'stroke-width':1.1,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(midi),style:'cursor:pointer'}));
      svgNoteLabel(svg,labelForPc(mod12(midi),nameMap.get(midi)||noteName(midi,useFlats)),bx+13,109.5,{'font-size':10,maxTextLength:13,fill:colors.text,'font-weight':isRoot&&!isExcl?700:500,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(midi),style:'cursor:pointer'});
      if(fingerings&&fingerings.has(midi)){
        const fi=fingerings.get(midi);
        svgText(svg,String(fi.finger),bx+13,92,{'font-size':10,'font-weight':700,fill:fi.hand==='L'?'#ff8c8c':'#fff'});
      }
    }
  }
  return svg;
}

function renderChordFretboard({tuning,useFlats,position,startFret,fretCount,rootPc,noteNamesByPc,title,fingerings,excluded}){
  const numStrings=tuning.strings.length;
  const boardW=numStrings>5?330:292;
  const innerW=boardW-84;
  const strSpacing=numStrings>1?innerW/(numStrings-1):innerW;
  const fretSpacing=306/fretCount;
  const dotR=Math.min(22.2,strSpacing/2-2.2,fretSpacing/2-2.4);
  const dotRS=Math.min(17.5,dotR,18);
  const labelSize=0.92*dotR,labelMaxLen=1.5*dotR;
  const labelSizeS=0.92*dotRS,labelMaxLenS=1.5*dotRS;
  const svg=createSvg(boardW,444);
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('title')).textContent=title;
  svgBackground(svg,boardW,444);
  svgDiagramTitle(svg,title,boardW,true);
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:42,y:84,width:innerW,height:306,fill:COLORS.board,stroke:COLORS.border}));
  for(let s=0;s<numStrings;s++){
    const x=42+s*strSpacing;
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x,y1:84,x2:x,y2:390,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.3}));
    svgText(svg,tuning.strings[s].label,x,410,{'font-size':17,fill:COLORS.softLine});
  }
  for(let f=0;f<=fretCount;f++){
    const y=84+f*fretSpacing;
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:42,y1:y,x2:42+innerW,y2:y,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':f===0&&startFret===0?5:1.6}));
  }
  // position dots, as on the neck: frets 3 5 7 9 15 17 19 21, two at 12 and 24
  for(let rel=1;rel<=fretCount;rel++){
    const f=startFret===0?rel:startFret+rel-1,cy=84+rel*fretSpacing-fretSpacing/2,m=f%12;
    if(f>0&&m===0)[0.3,0.7].forEach(k=>svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:42+innerW*k,cy,r:9,fill:'#c4c0b7'})));
    else if(m===3||m===5||m===7||m===9)svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:42+innerW/2,cy,r:9,fill:'#c4c0b7'}));
  }
  // fret number, large, beside the first row where the lowest string has no note to cover it
  if(startFret>0){
    const low=position.strings[0],lowRel=low&&low.fret!=null&&low.fret>0?low.fret-startFret+1:-1,rel=lowRel===1&&fretCount>1?2:1;
    // a gutter on the left makes room for it at a readable size
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`-34 0 ${boardW+34} 444`);
    svg.insertBefore(svgEl('rect',{x:-34,y:0,width:34,height:444,fill:COLORS.page}),svg.firstChild);
    svgText(svg,`${startFret+rel-1}fr`,36,84+rel*fretSpacing-fretSpacing/2+9,{'font-size':27,'font-weight':700,'text-anchor':'end',fill:COLORS.label});
  }
  (position.barres||[]).forEach(barre=>{
    const relFret=startFret===0?barre.fret:barre.fret-startFret+1;
    if(relFret<=0||relFret>fretCount)return;
    const bx=42+barre.startString*strSpacing,bx2=42+barre.endString*strSpacing;
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:bx,y:84+relFret*fretSpacing-fretSpacing/2-7,width:bx2-bx,height:14,rx:7,fill:'#e6e6e6',stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.1}));
  });
  position.strings.forEach((str,si)=>{
    if(!str||str.hidden)return;
    const x=42+si*strSpacing;
    if(str.fret===null){svgText(svg,'X',x,67,{'font-size':17,'font-weight':700,fill:COLORS.label});return}
    const isOpen=str.fret===0&&startFret===0;
    const relFret=startFret===0?str.fret:str.fret-startFret+1;
    const cy=isOpen?62:84+relFret*fretSpacing-fretSpacing/2;
    const isRoot=str.isRoot;
    const isExcl=excluded&&excluded.has(mod12(str.pc));
    const colors=isExcl?EXCL_COLORS:markerColors(isRoot);const r=isOpen?dotRS:dotR;
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:x,cy,r,fill:colors.fill,stroke:colors.stroke,'stroke-width':1.6,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(str.pc),style:'cursor:pointer'}));
    svgNoteLabel(svg,labelForPc(str.pc,(noteNamesByPc&&noteNamesByPc[str.pc])||noteName(str.pc,useFlats)),x,cy+0.5,{'font-size':isOpen?labelSizeS:labelSize,maxTextLength:isOpen?labelMaxLenS:labelMaxLen,fill:colors.text,'font-weight':isRoot&&!isExcl?700:500,'class':'note-marker','data-pc':mod12(str.pc),style:'cursor:pointer'});
  });
  if(fingerings){
    fingerings.forEach((f,si)=>{
      if(f==null)return;
      const x=42+si*strSpacing;
      svgText(svg,String(f),x,432,{'font-size':13,'font-weight':700,fill:'#555'});
    });
  }
  return svg;
}

// ===== CHORD SYMBOL PARSER =====
const SYMBOL_MAP = new Map();
DATA.chordGroups.forEach(g=>g.items.forEach(item=>{
  if(!SYMBOL_MAP.has(item.symbol)) SYMBOL_MAP.set(item.symbol, item.id);
}));
[['maj','major'],['major','major'],['M','major'],['min','minor'],['minor','minor'],
 ['+','aug'],['o','dim'],['°','dim'],['ø','m7b5'],['Δ','maj7'],['Δ7','maj7'],['dom7','7'],['dom','7']
].forEach(([sym,id])=>{ if(!SYMBOL_MAP.has(sym)) SYMBOL_MAP.set(sym,id); });
const SYMBOL_ENTRIES=[...SYMBOL_MAP.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[0].length-a[0].length);

function parseChordToken(token){
  const m=token.match(/^([A-G][#b♯♭]?)/);
  if(!m) return null;
  const rootNote=parseNote(m[1].replace('♯','#').replace('♭','b'));
  if(!rootNote) return null;
  const quality=token.slice(m[1].length);
  for(const [sym,id] of SYMBOL_ENTRIES){ if(quality===sym) return {rootPc:rootNote.pc,chordId:id,rootName:rootNote.name}; }
  return null;
}

// ===== TYPED ROOT (Add by type) =====
// "C", "f#", "Bb", "E♭" -> { pc, name } or null
function parseRootInput(text){
  const m=/^\s*([A-Ga-g])\s*([#b♯♭]?)\s*$/.exec(text||'');
  if(!m)return null;
  const L=m[1].toUpperCase(),acc=m[2]==='#'||m[2]==='♯'?1:m[2]?-1:0;
  return{pc:mod12({C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11}[L]+acc),name:L+(acc>0?'#':acc<0?'b':'')};
}

// ===== VOICING HELPERS =====
function ordinal(n){return n===1?'1st':n===2?'2nd':n===3?'3rd':`${n}th`}

function getPositionLabels(positions){
  if(positions.length&&positions.every(p=>p.label))return positions.map(p=>p.label);
  const raw=positions.map(pos=>{
    const nonZero=pos.strings.filter(s=>s&&s.fret>0);
    const hasOpen=pos.strings.some(s=>s&&s.fret===0);
    const mainBarre=(pos.barres||[]).find(b=>b.type==='main');
    const minFret=nonZero.length?Math.min(...nonZero.map(s=>s.fret)):0;
    if(hasOpen&&pos.startFret===0) return 'Open';
    if(mainBarre) return `Barre — ${mainBarre.fret} fr.`;
    return `${minFret} fr.`;
  });
  const counts={};
  raw.forEach(l=>{counts[l]=(counts[l]||0)+1});
  const seen={};
  return raw.map(l=>{
    if(counts[l]<=1) return l;
    seen[l]=(seen[l]||0)+1;
    return `${l} (${seen[l]})`;
  });
}

// ===== APP STATE =====
// Each parsedToken: {token, rootPc?, chordId?, valid, voicings:{instId→idx}, positionCache:{tuningId→positions[]}}
const S = {
  instruments: new Map(DATA.instruments.map(inst=>[inst.id,{enabled:inst.id==='keyboard',tuningId:inst.defaultTuningId||'',voicingStyle:'standard'}])),
  picker: { rootPc: 0, chordId: 'major' }
};
let parsedTokens = [];
let playedInst=null;                 // instrument id offering the "As played" style after a hand-off
const UI={};                         // per instrument: its checkbox and menus (for the hand-off import)

function makeToken(token, parsed){
  if(parsed) return {token,...parsed,valid:true,voicings:{},octShifts:{},positionCache:{}};
  return {token,valid:false,voicings:{},octShifts:{},positionCache:{}};
}

function parseTextarea(){
  const ta=document.getElementById('chords-textarea');
  const strings=ta.value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const old=parsedTokens;
  parsedTokens=strings.map((token,i)=>{
    // Reuse existing object at same position to preserve voicings/cache
    if(old[i]&&old[i].token===token) return old[i];
    return makeToken(token, parseChordToken(token));
  });
  renderChips();
  updateKeyLabel();
  applyAllVoiceLeading();
  scheduleRender();
}

function syncTextarea(){
  document.getElementById('chords-textarea').value=parsedTokens.map(t=>t.token).join(' ');
}

function removeToken(idx){
  parsedTokens.splice(idx,1);
  syncTextarea();
  renderChips();
  applyAllVoiceLeading();
  scheduleRender();
}

function appendToken(rootPc, chordId, rootName){
  const chord=getChord(chordId);
  if(!chord) return;
  const sym=rootName+chord.symbol;
  parsedTokens.push(makeToken(sym,{rootPc,chordId,rootName}));
  syncTextarea();
  renderChips();
  applyAllVoiceLeading();
  scheduleRender();
}

function renderChips(){
  const chips=document.getElementById('chords-chips');
  const countEl=document.getElementById('chord-count');
  const valid=parsedTokens.filter(t=>t.valid).length;
  countEl.textContent=valid+' chord'+(valid!==1?'s':'');
  chips.innerHTML='';
  parsedTokens.forEach((t,idx)=>{
    const chip=document.createElement('span');
    chip.className='chord-chip'+(t.valid?'':' bad');
    if(!t.valid) chip.title='Unrecognized — check spelling';
    const label=document.createElement('span');
    if(t.valid){const chord=getChord(t.chordId);label.textContent=chord?chordLabel(t,t.rootName?t.rootName+chord.symbol:chordDisplayName(t.rootPc,chord)):t.token}
    else label.textContent=t.token;
    const del=document.createElement('button');
    del.className='chip-del';del.textContent='×';del.title='Remove';
    del.addEventListener('click',()=>removeToken(idx));
    chip.appendChild(label);chip.appendChild(del);chips.appendChild(chip);
  });
}

// ===== CHORD NAME DISPLAY (letters / Roman numerals / both) =====
let chordDisplay='letters';
// The tool's chord id → [quality PitchSpelling.romanNumeral knows, text to append]. Chords it
// has no figure for take the plain major/minor numeral plus their own suffix.
const ROMAN_QUALITY={
  major:['maj',''],minor:['min',''],'5':['maj','5'],sus2:['maj','sus2'],sus4:['maj','sus4'],'6':['6',''],m6:['m6',''],
  '7':['7',''],maj7:['maj7',''],m7:['min7',''],add9:['maj','add9'],madd9:['min','(add9)'],'9':['maj','9'],maj9:['maj','maj9'],
  m9:['min','9'],'11':['maj','11'],m11:['min','11'],'13':['maj','13'],maj13:['maj','maj13'],m13:['min','13'],
  '7sus4':['maj','7sus4'],'7b9':['maj','7b9'],'7#9':['maj','7#9'],'7b5':['7b5',''],'7#5':['7#5',''],'7b13':['maj','7b13'],'7alt':['maj','7alt'],
  dim:['dim',''],dim7:['dim7',''],m7b5:['m7b5',''],aug:['aug',''],aug7:['7#5',''],augMaj7:['maj7#5',''],mMaj7:['mmaj7','']
};
// "ii7", "V7", "Imaj7" … for a chord token in the key context; '' when the shared roman logic
// (apps/shared/pitch-spelling.js) is not loaded or knows no figure.
function romanForToken(t){
  const spec=ROMAN_QUALITY[t.chordId];
  if(!spec||!window.PitchSpelling)return'';
  try{
    const r=PitchSpelling.romanNumeral(t.rootPc,spec[0],{tonicPc:currentKeyContext().tonicPc});
    return r.replace('M','maj')+spec[1];            // the library writes a major 7th as M7
  }catch(e){return''}
}
function chordLabel(t,letters){
  if(chordDisplay==='letters')return letters;
  const r=romanForToken(t);
  if(!r)return letters;
  return chordDisplay==='roman'?r:letters+' · '+r;
}

// ===== NOTATION (abcjs, loaded the first time it is switched on) =====
let showNotation=false,abcLoading=null;
function loadAbcjs(){
  if(window.ABCJS)return Promise.resolve();
  if(!abcLoading)abcLoading=new Promise((res,rej)=>{
    const sc=document.createElement('script');sc.src='/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js';
    sc.onload=res;sc.onerror=()=>{abcLoading=null;rej(new Error('abcjs failed to load'))};
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
  });
  return abcLoading;
}

// One note in ABC: spelled letter and accidentals from the chord, octave from the pitch. A
// natural sign is written only where the same letter is altered elsewhere in the chord.
function abcPitch(n,altered){
  const pn=parseNote(n.name||'')||parseNote(noteName(n.midi,false));
  const oct=Math.floor((n.midi-pn.accidental)/12)-1;
  const acc=pn.accidental>0?'^'.repeat(pn.accidental):pn.accidental<0?'_'.repeat(-pn.accidental):(altered.has(pn.letter)?'=':'');
  return acc+(oct>=5?pn.letter.toLowerCase()+"'".repeat(oct-5):pn.letter+','.repeat(Math.max(0,4-oct)));
}
// items [{midi,name}] → one whole-note chord. Keyboard: a single staff when the notes sit
// within a ledger line of it (treble from B3 up, bass up to middle C), else a grand staff split
// at middle C. Guitar: treble clef, written an octave above the sounding pitch.
function notationAbc(items,guitar){
  const notes=items.map(n=>({...n,midi:guitar?n.midi+12:n.midi})).sort((a,b)=>a.midi-b.midi);
  if(!notes.length)return'';
  const altered=new Set(notes.map(n=>parseNote(n.name||'')).filter(p=>p&&p.accidental!==0).map(p=>p.letter));
  const chord=list=>list.length?(list.length>1?'['+list.map(n=>abcPitch(n,altered)).join('')+']':abcPitch(list[0],altered))+'1':'x1';
  const lo=notes[0].midi,hi=notes[notes.length-1].midi;
  const head='X:1\nM:none\nL:1/1\n';
  if(guitar||(lo>=59&&hi<=81))return head+'K:C clef=treble\n'+chord(notes)+'|]\n';
  if(lo>=40&&hi<=60)return head+'K:C clef=bass\n'+chord(notes)+'|]\n';
  return head+'%%staves {1 2}\nV:1 clef=treble\nV:2 clef=bass\nK:C\n[V:1] '+chord(notes.filter(n=>n.midi>=60))+'|]\n[V:2] '+chord(notes.filter(n=>n.midi<60))+'|]\n';
}
function drawNotation(wrap,notes){
  wrap.innerHTML='';
  if(!notes||!notes.items.length)return;
  if(!window.ABCJS){wrap.textContent='Loading notation…';return}
  const abc=notationAbc(notes.items,notes.guitar);
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.style.cssText='width:144px;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto';   // abcjs scales the staff to this box
  const host=document.createElement('div');box.appendChild(host);wrap.appendChild(box);
  try{
    ABCJS.renderAbc(host,abc,{responsive:'resize',staffwidth:130,paddingtop:2,paddingbottom:2,paddingleft:2,paddingright:2,add_classes:true});
  }catch(e){wrap.textContent='Notation unavailable';return}
}

// ===== DIAGRAM CARD =====
// ===== SUPERIMPOSED VIEW =====
// Up to four chords drawn together, each a voice-led inversion of the one before, so the hand stays
// in one place: on the keyboard one lane per chord over a shared row of keys (after the Music Will
// jam cards), on a fretboard one colour per chord with split dots where chords share a note.
let superOn=false,superLane='names',superDot='fingers',superSel=[],superOnly=false;
const SUPER_COLORS=['#2b9c90','#d6336c','#d98a00','#4c5fd5'];
const SUPER_DEG=['R','♭2','2','♭3','3','4','♭5','5','♯5','6','♭7','7'],SUPER_NUM=['1','♭2','2','♭3','3','4','♯4','5','♭6','6','♭7','7'];
function superLetters(t){const c=getChord(t.chordId);return(t.rootName?t.rootName+c.symbol:chordDisplayName(t.rootPc,c))+(t.superBassName?'/'+t.superBassName:'')}
// Sections: lines of the Sections box -> [{ name, tokens, extra, bad }]. Their chords are separate from the
// chord list's, so C can be root position in one section and C/E in another. A slash names the lowest note.
let superSectionCache={text:null,list:[]};
function superSections(){
  const ta=document.getElementById('super-sections'),text=ta?ta.value:'';
  if(text===superSectionCache.text)return superSectionCache.list;
  const list=[];
  text.split(/\n/).forEach(line=>{
    if(!line.trim())return;
    const m=/^\s*([^:]*):(.*)$/.exec(line),name=m?m[1].trim():'',body=m?m[2]:line,tokens=[],bad=[];
    body.split(/[\s,|]+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(tok=>{
      const parts=tok.split('/'),parsed=parseChordToken(parts[0]),t=makeToken(tok,parsed);
      if(!t.valid||!getChord(t.chordId)){bad.push(tok);return}
      if(parts[1]){const bn=parseRootInput(parts[1]);if(bn){t.superBass=bn.pc;t.superBassName=bn.name}else{bad.push(tok);return}}
      tokens.push(t);
    });
    if(tokens.length||bad.length)list.push({name:name||('Section '+(list.length+1)),tokens:tokens.slice(0,4),extra:Math.max(0,tokens.length-4),bad});
  });
  superSectionCache={text,list};
  return list;
}
// the chords on show: every different chord once; the ticked four when there are more
function superChords(validTokens){
  const seen=new Set(),uniq=[];
  validTokens.forEach(t=>{if(getChord(t.chordId)&&!seen.has(t.token)){seen.add(t.token);uniq.push(t)}});
  let picked=uniq.filter(t=>superSel.includes(t.token));
  if(uniq.length<=4)picked=uniq;else if(!picked.length)picked=uniq.slice(0,4);
  picked=picked.slice(0,4);
  superSel=picked.map(t=>t.token);
  return{uniq,picked};
}
function superLabel(t){
  const letters=superLetters(t);
  if(superLane==='roman')return romanForToken(t)||letters;
  if(superLane==='numbers'){let tonic=null;try{tonic=currentKeyContext().tonicPc}catch(e){}return tonic==null?letters:SUPER_NUM[mod12(t.rootPc-tonic)]}
  return letters;
}
function superDotText(t,midi,finger){
  if(superDot==='fingers')return finger==null?'':String(finger);
  if(superDot==='degrees')return SUPER_DEG[mod12(midi-t.rootPc)];
  if(superDot==='solfege'){let sf='';try{sf=solfegeForPc(mod12(midi))||''}catch(e){}if(sf)return sf.replace(/#/g,'♯').replace(/b/g,'♭')}   // (no key set: note names)
  const rn=t.rootName?parseNote(t.rootName):null,flats=rn&&rn.accidental!==0?rn.accidental<0:preferFlats(t.rootPc);
  return noteName(mod12(midi),flats);
}
// keyboard: the first chord as its card shows it, each later chord the inversion nearest the one before
function superKeyboardVoicings(tokens,instId,styleId){
  let prev=null,home=null;
  return tokens.map(t=>{
    const chord=getChord(t.chordId),n=Math.max(1,kbInvCount(t.rootPc,chord,styleId));
    let best=null,bs=Infinity;
    const fixed=!!(t.manual&&t.manual[instId]);                          // picked by hand on its card: used as it is
    if(fixed){const fm=kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,styleId,Math.min(t.voicings[instId]??0,n-1),(t.octShifts&&t.octShifts[instId])||0).slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      best={midis:fm,ctr:fm.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/fm.length}}
    else for(let pass=0;pass<2&&!best;pass++)for(let inv=0;inv<n;inv++)for(let oct=-1;oct<=1;oct++){
      const midis=kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,styleId,inv,oct).slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      if(!kbOctOk(styleId,midis))continue;
      if(pass===0&&t.superBass!=null&&mod12(midis[0])!==t.superBass)continue;      // a slash chord: that note at the bottom (when the style has such a shape)
      const ctr=midis.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/midis.length;
      const inv0=Math.min(t.voicings[instId]??0,n-1),oct0=(t.octShifts&&t.octShifts[instId])||0;
```
