      const score=prev?voiceLeadingDistance(prev,midis)+0.35*Math.abs(ctr-home):(inv===inv0&&oct===oct0?0:1+Math.abs(inv-inv0)+3*Math.abs(oct-oct0)+(t.superBass!=null?Math.abs(ctr-60)/12:0));
      if(score<bs){bs=score;best={midis,ctr}}
    }
    if(!best)best={midis:kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,styleId,0,0).slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b),ctr:60};
    if(home==null)home=best.ctr;
    prev=best.midis;
    const fmap=computeKeyboardFingerings(best.midis.map(m=>({midi:m})),kbHandMode,t.rootPc);
    return{t,midis:best.midis,fingers:best.midis.map(m=>fmap.get(m))};
  });
}
// fretboard: the first chord as its card shows it, each later chord the easiest move for the hand
function superFretVoicings(tokens,inst,tuning,styleId){
  let prevGrip=null,prevMidis=null,home=5;
  return tokens.map(t=>{
    const positions=getPositions(t,tuning,getChord(t.chordId),styleId);
    if(!positions.length)return{t,pos:null};
    let cands=positions.map((pos,i)=>({i,midis:positionMidis(pos),strings:pos.strings.map((x,k)=>x&&x.fret!==null?{string:k,fret:x.fret}:null).filter(Boolean)}));
    let idx=Math.min(t.voicings[inst.id]??0,positions.length-1);
    if(t.superBass!=null){                                                 // a slash chord: that note lowest, when a shape has it there
      const withBass=cands.filter(c=>c.midis.length&&mod12(Math.min(...c.midis))===t.superBass);
      if(withBass.length){cands=withBass;idx=withBass[0].i}
    }
    if(t.manual&&t.manual[inst.id]){}                                    // picked by hand on its card: used as it is
    else if(prevGrip&&CV&&CV.easiest)idx=CV.easiest(cands,prevGrip,prevMidis,home).i;
    else if(prevMidis){let bs=Infinity;cands.forEach(c=>{const sc=voiceLeadingDistance(prevMidis,c.midis);if(sc<bs){bs=sc;idx=c.i}})}
    const chosen=cands.find(c=>c.i===idx)||cands[0];idx=chosen.i;
    if(!prevGrip){const fr=chosen.strings.map(x=>x.fret).filter(f=>f>0);home=fr.length?Math.min(...fr):1}
    prevGrip=chosen.strings;prevMidis=chosen.midis;
    return{t,pos:positions[idx],fingers:computeFretboardFingerings(positions[idx])};
  });
}
// A voicing on the band's sampled instruments (the sounds of the Backing Track page): piano for the
// keyboard, guitar for fretted instruments, electric bass for a bass. Falls back to the plain synth.
function hearChord(midis,inst){
  if(!midis||!midis.length)return;
  const sound=!inst||inst.type==='keyboard'?'piano':/bass/i.test(inst.id||'')?'ebass':'guitar';
  if(window.BandPlayer&&BandPlayer.chord){BandPlayer.chord(midis,{inst:sound,dur:1.8}).catch(()=>{if(window.MusicAudio)MusicAudio.chord(midis,1.3)});return}
  if(window.MusicAudio)MusicAudio.chord(midis,1.3);
}
function superPlay(el,midis){el.addEventListener('click',()=>hearChord(midis,null))}
function renderSuperKeyboard(voiced){
  const all=voiced.flatMap(v=>v.midis),{startMidi,endMidi,whites}=selectKeyboardRange(all);
  const G=104,WW=40,LH=50,top=8,kbY=top+LH*voiced.length+8,KH=118,w=G+WW*whites.length+10,h=kbY+KH+8;
  const svg=createSvg(w,h);svg.style.width=w+'px';
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:0,y:0,width:w,height:h,fill:'#fff'}));
  const wx=new Map();whites.forEach((m,i)=>wx.set(m,G+WW*i));
  const xOf=m=>isWhiteKey(m)?wx.get(m)+WW/2:wx.get(previousWhiteMidi(m-1))+WW;
  // the lanes, with the key edges carried up through them
  voiced.forEach((v,k)=>{
    const y=top+LH*k,col=SUPER_COLORS[k];
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:G,y,width:WW*whites.length,height:LH,fill:col,opacity:0.07}));
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:0,y1:y+LH,x2:w,y2:y+LH,stroke:'#e3e0da','stroke-width':1}));
  });
  whites.forEach((m,i)=>svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:G+WW*i,y1:top,x2:G+WW*i,y2:kbY,stroke:'#e3e0da','stroke-width':1})));
  voiced.forEach((v,k)=>{
    const y=top+LH*k,cy=y+LH/2+3,col=SUPER_COLORS[k],xs=v.midis.map(xOf);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:Math.min(...xs),y:cy-5,width:Math.max(...xs)-Math.min(...xs),height:10,fill:'#9aa3b2',opacity:0.55}));
    const lab=svgText(svg,superLabel(v.t),G-10,cy+6,{'font-size':superLabel(v.t).length>6?15:19,'font-weight':800,'text-anchor':'end',fill:col,'class':'super-lane-label'});
    superPlay(lab,v.midis);
    v.midis.forEach((m,i)=>{
      const x=xOf(m),isRoot=mod12(m)===mod12(v.t.rootPc),black=!isWhiteKey(m),sz=black?26:32;
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:x-sz/2,y:cy-sz/2,width:sz,height:sz,rx:3,fill:isRoot?col:'#fff',stroke:col,'stroke-width':black?3:2}));
      if(isRoot)svgText(svg,'ROOT',x,cy-sz/2-3,{'font-size':8,'font-weight':800,fill:col,'letter-spacing':'.04em'});
      const f=v.fingers[i],txt=superDotText(v.t,m,f&&f.finger);
      svgText(svg,txt,x,cy+5,{'font-size':txt.length>2?11:15,'font-weight':800,fill:isRoot?'#fff':'#222'});
    });
  });
  // the keys themselves
  whites.forEach((m,i)=>{
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:G+WW*i,y:kbY,width:WW,height:KH,fill:'#fff',stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.2}));
    if(mod12(m)===0)svgText(svg,'C',G+WW*i+WW/2,kbY+KH-8,{'font-size':11,fill:COLORS.softLine});
  });
  for(let m=startMidi;m<=endMidi;m++){
    if(isWhiteKey(m))continue;
    const lo=previousWhiteMidi(m-1),hi=nextWhiteMidi(m+1);
    if(!wx.has(lo)||!wx.has(hi))continue;
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:wx.get(lo)+WW-12,y:kbY,width:24,height:KH*0.62,fill:COLORS.blackKey,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.2}));
  }
  return svg;
}
function renderSuperFretboard(voiced,tuning){
  const ok=voiced.filter(v=>v.pos),n=tuning.strings.length;
  const frets=ok.flatMap(v=>v.pos.strings.filter(x=>x&&x.fret>0).map(x=>x.fret));
  const lo=frets.length?Math.min(...frets):1,hi=frets.length?Math.max(...frets):4;
  const start=lo<=2?0:lo,rows=Math.max(5,hi-(start===0?1:start)+1);
  const G=96,SS=46,FS=58,rowH=20,top=10,headY=top+rowH*ok.length+14,boardW=SS*(n-1),w=G+boardW+40,h=headY+FS*rows+34;
  const svg=createSvg(w,h);svg.style.width=w+'px';
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:0,y:0,width:w,height:h,fill:'#fff'}));
  const sx=i=>G+SS*i,fy=f=>headY+((start===0?f:f-start+1)-0.5)*FS;
  // one row per chord above the nut: its label, and which strings are open (o) or not played (x)
  ok.forEach((v,k)=>{
    const y=top+rowH*k+14,col=SUPER_COLORS[voiced.indexOf(v)];
    const lab=svgText(svg,superLabel(v.t),G-22,y,{'font-size':15,'font-weight':800,'text-anchor':'end',fill:col,'class':'super-lane-label'});
    superPlay(lab,positionMidis(v.pos));
    v.pos.strings.forEach((x,i)=>{if(!x||x.fret===null)svgText(svg,'×',sx(i),y,{'font-size':14,'font-weight':700,fill:col});else if(x.fret===0)svgText(svg,'○',sx(i),y,{'font-size':13,'font-weight':700,fill:col})});
  });
  svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect',{x:G,y:headY,width:boardW,height:FS*rows,fill:COLORS.board,stroke:COLORS.border}));
  for(let r=1;r<=rows;r++){
    const f=start===0?r:start+r-1,cy=headY+(r-0.5)*FS,m=f%12;
    if(m===0)[0.3,0.7].forEach(q=>svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:G+boardW*q,cy,r:7,fill:'#c4c0b7'})));
    else if(m===3||m===5||m===7||m===9)svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx:G+boardW/2,cy,r:7,fill:'#c4c0b7'}));
    svgText(svg,String(f),G-30,cy+6,{'font-size':17,'font-weight':700,'text-anchor':'end',fill:COLORS.label});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:sx(i),y1:headY,x2:sx(i),y2:headY+FS*rows,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':1.3}));svgText(svg,tuning.strings[i].label,sx(i),headY+FS*rows+20,{'font-size':14,fill:COLORS.softLine})}
  for(let r=0;r<=rows;r++)svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:G,y1:headY+r*FS,x2:G+boardW,y2:headY+r*FS,stroke:COLORS.line,'stroke-width':r===0&&start===0?5:1.6}));
  // the notes: who plays each fretted spot
  const spots=new Map();
  ok.forEach(v=>{const k=voiced.indexOf(v);v.pos.strings.forEach((x,i)=>{if(!x||!(x.fret>0))return;const key=i+':'+x.fret;if(!spots.has(key))spots.set(key,{i,fret:x.fret,by:[]});spots.get(key).by.push({k,v,x,finger:v.fingers[i]})})});
  spots.forEach(sp=>{
    const cx=sx(sp.i),cy=fy(sp.fret),m=sp.by.length,R=m>1?20:18;
    if(m===1)svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx,cy,r:R,fill:SUPER_COLORS[sp.by[0].k]}));
    else sp.by.forEach((b,q)=>{
      const a0=-Math.PI/2+2*Math.PI*q/m,a1=-Math.PI/2+2*Math.PI*(q+1)/m;
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('path',{d:`M${cx},${cy} L${cx+R*Math.cos(a0)},${cy+R*Math.sin(a0)} A${R},${R} 0 ${a1-a0>Math.PI?1:0} 1 ${cx+R*Math.cos(a1)},${cy+R*Math.sin(a1)} Z`,fill:SUPER_COLORS[b.k]}));
    });
    const root=sp.by.some(b=>b.x.isRoot);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle',{cx,cy,r:R,fill:'none',stroke:root?'#111':'#fff','stroke-width':root?3.5:1.5}));
    // one label when the chords agree on it; otherwise each slice carries its own chord's label
    const each=sp.by.map(b=>superDotText(b.v.t,b.x.midi,b.finger)),texts=[...new Set(each)];
    if(texts.length===1){if(texts[0])svgText(svg,texts[0],cx,cy+5,{'font-size':texts[0].length>2?11:15,'font-weight':800,fill:'#fff'})}
    else each.forEach((txt,q)=>{
      if(!txt)return;
      const mid=-Math.PI/2+2*Math.PI*(q+0.5)/m,rr=m===2?R*0.5:R*0.58;
      svgText(svg,txt,cx+rr*Math.cos(mid),cy+rr*Math.sin(mid)+4,{'font-size':txt.length>1?8.5:(m>3?10:11.5),'font-weight':800,fill:'#fff'});
    });
  });
  return svg;
}
// the block for one instrument, or null when the view does not cover it
function buildSuperBlock(inst,tuning,picked){
  if(inst.type!=='keyboard'&&inst.type!=='fretted')return null;      // every keyboard and fretted instrument (guitar, bass, ukulele, ...)
  const menuStyle=(S.instruments.get(inst.id).voicingStyle)||'standard';
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='super-card';
  const note=document.createElement('p');note.className='super-note';
  if(inst.type==='keyboard'){
    box.appendChild(renderSuperKeyboard(superKeyboardVoicings(picked,inst.id,menuStyle===PLAYED?'standard':menuStyle)));
    note.textContent='One lane per chord over the same keys; each chord is the inversion nearest the one before, unless you chose its inversion on its own card. Filled square = root. Click a chord label to hear it.';
  }else{
    box.appendChild(renderSuperFretboard(superFretVoicings(picked,inst,tuning,menuStyle),tuning));
    note.textContent='One colour per chord; a split dot is shared by the chords whose colours it shows. Dark ring = root. × not played, ○ open string. Click a chord label to hear it.';
  }
  box.appendChild(note);
  return box;
}
// the row of chords to tick, when there are more than four
function renderSuperPicks(uniq,picked){
  const host=document.getElementById('super-picks');host.innerHTML='';
  if(!superOn||uniq.length<=4)return;
  host.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Show four of these:'));
  uniq.forEach(t=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button'),k=picked.indexOf(t);b.type='button';b.textContent=superLetters(t);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(k>=0));
    if(k>=0)b.style.background=SUPER_COLORS[k];
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(k>=0){if(superSel.length>1)superSel=superSel.filter(x=>x!==t.token)}
      else if(superSel.length<4)superSel=[...superSel,t.token];
      else{superSel=[...superSel.slice(1),t.token]}                    // a fifth tick replaces the earliest one
      scheduleRender();
    });
    host.appendChild(b);
  });
}

function buildDiagramCard(inst, tuning, t){
  const baseChord=getChord(t.chordId);
  if(!baseChord) return null;
  const isKeyboard=inst.type==='keyboard';
  const menuStyle=(S.instruments.get(inst.id).voicingStyle)||'standard';
  const played=menuStyle===PLAYED&&!!t.played;            // notes handed over by the Backing Track
  const styleId=menuStyle===PLAYED&&!t.played?'standard':menuStyle;
  const chord=isKeyboard?baseChord:applyVoicingStyle(baseChord,styleId);   // keyboard styles shape the full chord themselves
  const rootNote=t.rootName?parseNote(t.rootName):null;
  const useFlats=rootNote&&rootNote.accidental!==0?rootNote.accidental<0:preferFlats(t.rootPc);
  const displayName=chordLabel(t,t.rootName?t.rootName+baseChord.symbol:chordDisplayName(t.rootPc,baseChord));

  const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='diagram-card';
  t.excluded=t.excluded||{};
  t.shown=t.shown||{};
  let redraw=()=>{};
  // Click the chord LABEL to play the current voicing; click a NOTE circle to
  // include/exclude it from the voicing (greyed = excluded). Screen only — no
  // effect in the PDF export.
  card.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    if(e.target.closest('select'))return;
    if(e.target.closest('.diagram-title')){
      hearChord(card._midis,inst);
      return;
    }
    const nm=e.target.closest('.note-marker');
    if(nm){
      const pc=Number(nm.getAttribute('data-pc')), s=t.excluded[inst.id];
      if(s){ s.has(pc)?s.delete(pc):s.add(pc); redraw(); }
    }
  });
  const svgWrap=document.createElement('div');svgWrap.className='diagram-svg-wrap';
  card.appendChild(svgWrap);

  // What the card sounds (kept for "Play with the band") and its notation, when switched on.
  function shown(midis,items,guitar){
    card._midis=midis;
    t.shown[inst.id]=midis.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    card._notes={items,guitar};
    if(card._notate&&card.isConnected)card._notate();
  }
  function addNotation(){
    if(!showNotation)return;
    const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='notation-wrap';
    card.appendChild(wrap);
    card._notate=()=>drawNotation(wrap,card._notes);
  }
  // One-line picker under the diagram: every inversion/position, or just the "As played" tag.
  function addPicker(labels,current,onPick){
    const sel=document.createElement('select');sel.className='voicing-sel';
    labels.forEach((l,i)=>{
      const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=i;o.textContent=l;
      if(i===current)o.selected=true;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
    sel.title=labels[current];                          // full label on hover (long ones clip in a narrow card)
    // a voicing chosen by hand is remembered as such: the superimposed view keeps it exactly
    sel.addEventListener('change',()=>{sel.title=labels[sel.selectedIndex];(t.manual=t.manual||{})[inst.id]=true;onPick(Number(sel.value))});
    card.appendChild(sel);
  }

  if(isKeyboard){
    const dropCands=played?[]:kbCandidates(t.rootPc,chord,styleId);    // empty only without the library
    const maxInv=played?0:Math.max(0,kbInvCount(t.rootPc,chord,styleId)-1);
    let inv=Math.min(t.voicings[inst.id]??0, maxInv);
    let oct=(t.octShifts&&t.octShifts[inst.id])||0;

    if(!t.excluded[inst.id]){
      const excl=new Set();
      if(!played&&(styleId==='standard'||!dropCands.length)&&chord.intervals.length>3){   // Standard: show the 5th greyed (other styles are shown whole)
        const fifth=chord.intervals.find(iv=>mod12(iv)===7);
        if(fifth!==undefined) excl.add(mod12(t.rootPc+fifth));
      }
      t.excluded[inst.id]=excl;
    }
    addNotation();

    function drawKbd(){
      svgWrap.innerHTML='';
      const excl=t.excluded[inst.id];
      const midis=played?t.played.midis.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b):kbMidis(t.rootPc,chord,styleId,inv,oct);
      const tones=played?toneNames(t.rootPc,chord,rootNote,midis,null):kbTones(t.rootPc,chord,styleId,inv,rootNote,oct);
      svgWrap.appendChild(renderKeyboard({
        midis, tones,
        rootPc:t.rootPc,useFlats,title:displayName,excluded:excl,
        fingerings:showFingerings?computeKeyboardFingerings(tones,kbHandMode,t.rootPc):null
      }));
      shown(midis.filter(m=>!excl.has(mod12(m))),tones.filter(x=>!excl.has(mod12(x.midi))).map(x=>({midi:x.midi,name:x.name})),false);
    }
    redraw=drawKbd;
    drawKbd();

    if(played)addPicker(['As played'],0,()=>{});
    else if(maxInv>0){
      addPicker(Array.from({length:maxInv+1},(_,i)=>dropCands.length?dropCands[i].label:(i===0?'Root position':ordinal(i)+' inversion')),inv,i=>{
        inv=i;t.voicings[inst.id]=inv;oct=0;if(t.octShifts)t.octShifts[inst.id]=0;drawKbd();
      });
    }

  } else if(tuning){
    const positions=getPositions(t,tuning,baseChord,styleId);

    if(!positions.length){
      svgWrap.innerHTML='';
      const u=document.createElement('div');u.className='diagram-unavail';
      u.innerHTML=`<span>${displayName}</span><small>${played?'no fingering for these notes':'no voicing found'}</small>`;
      svgWrap.appendChild(u);
      return card;
    }

    const namesByPc=rootNote?spellNotesForItem(rootNote,chord,t.rootPc).reduce((m,tn)=>{if(!m[mod12(tn.pc)])m[mod12(tn.pc)]=tn.name;return m},{}):noteNamesByPitchClass(t.rootPc,chord);
    let posIdx=Math.min(t.voicings[inst.id]??0, positions.length-1);

    if(!t.excluded[inst.id]) t.excluded[inst.id]=new Set();
    addNotation();

    function drawFret(){
      svgWrap.innerHTML='';
      const excl=t.excluded[inst.id];
      const pos=positions[posIdx];
      const sounding=pos.strings.filter(s=>s&&s.fret!==null&&s.midi!=null&&!excl.has(mod12(s.pc)));
      svgWrap.appendChild(renderChordFretboard({
        tuning,useFlats,position:pos,
        startFret:pos.startFret,fretCount:pos.fretCount,
        rootPc:t.rootPc,noteNamesByPc:namesByPc,title:displayName,excluded:excl,
        fingerings:showFingerings?computeFretboardFingerings(pos):null
      }));
      shown(sounding.map(s=>s.midi),sounding.map(s=>({midi:s.midi,name:namesByPc[mod12(s.pc)]||noteName(s.pc,useFlats)})),inst.id==='guitar');
    }
    redraw=drawFret;
    drawFret();

    if(played||positions.length>1){
      const labels=getPositionLabels(positions);
      addPicker(labels,posIdx,i=>{
        posIdx=i;t.voicings[inst.id]=posIdx;
        if(isAlwaysLed(styleId)){(t.ledPick=t.ledPick||{})[inst.id]=i;applyAllVoiceLeading();scheduleRender();return}   // later chords follow this one
        drawFret();
      });
    }
  }

  return card;
}

// ===== UI INIT =====
const KEY_LABELS=['C','Db','D','Eb','E','F','F#','G','Ab','A','Bb','B'];

function updateKeyLabel(){
  const el=document.getElementById('key-auto-label');
  if(!el||manualKeyPc!=null){if(el)el.textContent='';return;}
  const w=buildPcWeight();
  const total=w.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0);
  if(total<3){el.textContent='';return;}
  el.textContent='Auto: '+KEY_LABELS[currentKeyContext().tonicPc]+' maj';
}

function initUI(){
  const ta=document.getElementById('chords-textarea');
  ta.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();parseTextarea();if(e.key==='Tab')ta.blur()}
  });
  ta.addEventListener('blur',()=>parseTextarea());
  document.getElementById('btn-clear-chords').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    ta.value='';parsedTokens=[];renderChips();scheduleRender();
  });

  // Chord type select
  const sel=document.getElementById('sel-chord-type');
  DATA.chordGroups.forEach(group=>{
    const og=document.createElement('optgroup');og.label=group.label;
    group.items.forEach(item=>{
      const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=item.id;
      o.textContent=item.label+(item.symbol?' ('+item.symbol+')':'');
      if(item.id===S.picker.chordId)o.selected=true;
      og.appendChild(o);
    });
    sel.appendChild(og);
  });
  sel.addEventListener('change',()=>{S.picker.chordId=sel.value});

  const rootInp=document.getElementById('inp-root');
  function addTyped(){
    const r=parseRootInput(rootInp.value);
    rootInp.classList.toggle('bad',!r);
    if(!r){rootInp.focus();return}
    appendToken(r.pc,S.picker.chordId,r.name);
    rootInp.select();
  }
  document.getElementById('btn-add-chord').addEventListener('click',addTyped);
  rootInp.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();addTyped()}});
  rootInp.addEventListener('input',()=>rootInp.classList.remove('bad'));
  // Subtle extras at the bottom of the page: the preview bar and the less common instruments (remembered)
  (function(){
    const root=document.getElementById('chord-sheet-root'),KEY='chordSheetExtras';
    let ex={};try{ex=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch(e){}
    const pb=document.getElementById('btn-extra-preview'),ib=document.getElementById('btn-extra-insts');
    function apply(){
      root.classList.toggle('no-preview',!ex.preview);root.classList.toggle('few-insts',!ex.insts);
      pb.textContent=ex.preview?'Hide the preview bar':'Show the preview bar (print, play with the band)';
      ib.textContent=ex.insts?'Hide banjo, mandolin and vihuela':'Show banjo, mandolin and vihuela';
    }
    function flip(k){ex[k]=!ex[k];try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(ex))}catch(e){}apply()}
    pb.addEventListener('click',()=>flip('preview'));ib.addEventListener('click',()=>flip('insts'));
    window.__csExtras=function(){
      // an extra instrument that is already switched on (a saved sheet) is never hidden
      if(!ex.insts&&EXTRA_INSTS.some(id=>S.instruments.get(id)&&S.instruments.get(id).enabled)){ex.insts=true}
      apply();
    };
    apply();
  })();

  // Instruments
  const instList=document.getElementById('instrument-list');
  DATA.instruments.forEach(inst=>{
    const ist=S.instruments.get(inst.id);
    const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='inst-row'+(EXTRA_INSTS.includes(inst.id)?' extra-inst':'');
    const lbl=document.createElement('label');lbl.className='inst-check';
    const cb=document.createElement('input');cb.type='checkbox';cb.checked=ist.enabled;cb.dataset.instId=inst.id;
    lbl.appendChild(cb);
    const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=inst.name;lbl.appendChild(strong);
    row.appendChild(lbl);
    let tuningSel=null;
    if(inst.tunings&&inst.tunings.length){
      tuningSel=document.createElement('select');
      tuningSel.className='tuning-sel'+(ist.enabled?' show':'');
      inst.tunings.forEach(t=>{
        const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.id;o.textContent=t.name;
        if(t.id===ist.tuningId)o.selected=true;tuningSel.appendChild(o);
      });
      tuningSel.addEventListener('change',()=>{
        // Clear positionCache for this tuning when tuning changes
        parsedTokens.forEach(t=>{if(t.positionCache)t.positionCache={}});
        S.instruments.get(inst.id).tuningId=tuningSel.value;
        if(fillStyles())resetStyleState();              // the new tuning can't play the old style
        applyAllVoiceLeading();
        scheduleRender();
      });
      row.appendChild(tuningSel);
    }
    // Voicing style select (fretted: rebuilt per tuning, see frettedStyleOptions)
    const isKb=inst.type==='keyboard';
    const styleSel=document.createElement('select');
    styleSel.className='tuning-sel'+(ist.enabled?' show':'');
    // Returns true when the current style had to fall back to Standard.
    function fillStyles(){
      const tuning=isKb?null:(inst.tunings.find(t=>t.id===ist.tuningId)||inst.tunings[0]||null);
      const styleOpts=(isKb?KB_STYLES:frettedStyleOptions(tuning)).slice();
      if(playedInst===inst.id)styleOpts.unshift({id:PLAYED,label:'As played'});   // after a Backing Track hand-off
      const lost=!styleOpts.some(o=>o.id===ist.voicingStyle);
      if(lost)ist.voicingStyle='standard';
      styleSel.innerHTML='';
      let groupEl=null;
      styleOpts.forEach(opt=>{
        const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=opt.id;o.textContent=opt.label;
        if(opt.id===ist.voicingStyle)o.selected=true;
        if(opt.group){
          if(!groupEl||groupEl.label!==opt.group){groupEl=document.createElement('optgroup');groupEl.label=opt.group;styleSel.appendChild(groupEl)}
          groupEl.appendChild(o);
        }else styleSel.appendChild(o);
      });
      return lost;
    }
    // Style affects which positions/inversions are generated, so invalidate caches, VL
    // picks and the per-card excluded notes.
    function resetStyleState(){
      parsedTokens.forEach(t=>{
        if(t.positionCache)t.positionCache={};
        if(t.voicings)delete t.voicings[inst.id];
        if(t.ledPick)delete t.ledPick[inst.id];
        if(t.manual)delete t.manual[inst.id];
        if(t.octShifts)delete t.octShifts[inst.id];
        if(t.excluded)delete t.excluded[inst.id];
      });
    }
    fillStyles();
    UI[inst.id]={cb,tuningSel,styleSel,fillStyles,resetStyleState};
    styleSel.addEventListener('change',()=>{
      S.instruments.get(inst.id).voicingStyle=styleSel.value;
      resetStyleState();
      applyAllVoiceLeading();
      scheduleRender();
    });
    row.appendChild(styleSel);
    cb.addEventListener('change',()=>{
      ist.enabled=cb.checked;
      if(tuningSel)tuningSel.classList.toggle('show',cb.checked);
      styleSel.classList.toggle('show',cb.checked);
      applyAllVoiceLeading();
      scheduleRender();
    });
    instList.appendChild(row);
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-inst-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const hidden=id=>EXTRA_INSTS.includes(id)&&document.getElementById('chord-sheet-root').classList.contains('few-insts');   // "All" = all that are on show
    DATA.instruments.forEach(inst=>{if(!hidden(inst.id))S.instruments.get(inst.id).enabled=true});
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-inst-id]').forEach(cb=>{if(!hidden(cb.dataset.instId))cb.checked=true});
    document.querySelectorAll('.tuning-sel').forEach(s=>s.classList.add('show'));
    applyAllVoiceLeading();
    scheduleRender();
  });
  document.getElementById('btn-inst-none').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    DATA.instruments.forEach(inst=>{S.instruments.get(inst.id).enabled=false});
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-inst-id]').forEach(cb=>{cb.checked=false});
    document.querySelectorAll('.tuning-sel').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('show'));
    scheduleRender();
  });

  document.getElementById('inp-title').addEventListener('input',scheduleRender);

  // Roman numeral entry
  const romanInput=document.getElementById('inp-roman');
  document.getElementById('btn-add-roman').addEventListener('click',addRomanChord);
  romanInput.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();addRomanChord();}});

  // Key selector
  const keySel=document.getElementById('sel-key');
  const autoOpt=document.createElement('option');autoOpt.value='';autoOpt.textContent='Auto-detect';keySel.appendChild(autoOpt);
  KEY_LABELS.forEach((name,pc)=>{
    const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=pc;o.textContent=name+' major';keySel.appendChild(o);
  });
  keySel.addEventListener('change',()=>{
    const v=keySel.value;
    manualKeyPc=v===''?null:Number(v);
    updateKeyLabel();
    if(chordDisplay!=='letters')renderChips();     // the numerals follow the key
    scheduleRender();
  });

  // Superimposed view and its live label choices
  document.getElementById('chk-super').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    superOn=e.target.checked;document.getElementById('chord-sheet-root').classList.toggle('super-on',superOn);scheduleRender();});
  (function(){
    const ta=document.getElementById('super-sections'),KEY='chordSheetSections';let tm=null;
    try{const sv=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(sv){ta.value=sv;document.getElementById('super-sections-box').open=true}}catch(e){}
    ta.addEventListener('input',()=>{clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,ta.value)}catch(e){}scheduleRender()},250)});
  })();
  document.getElementById('chk-super-only').addEventListener('change',e=>{superOnly=e.target.checked;scheduleRender()});
  document.getElementById('sel-super-lane').addEventListener('change',e=>{superLane=e.target.value;scheduleRender()});
  document.getElementById('sel-super-dot').addEventListener('change',e=>{superDot=e.target.value;scheduleRender()});
  // Solfege toggle
  document.getElementById('chk-solfege').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    showSolfege=e.target.checked;
    scheduleRender();
  });

  // Chord names: letters / Roman numerals / both (cards and chips; the typed text stays letters)
  document.getElementById('sel-chord-display').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    chordDisplay=e.target.value;
    renderChips();
    scheduleRender();
  });

  // Notation toggle: abcjs is fetched the first time it is switched on
  const nbtn=document.getElementById('btn-notation');
  nbtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const c=document.getElementById('chk-notation');c.checked=!c.checked;c.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))});
  document.getElementById('chk-notation').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    showNotation=e.target.checked;
    nbtn.textContent=showNotation?'Hide notation':'Show notation';nbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(showNotation));
    scheduleRender();
    if(showNotation&&!window.ABCJS)loadAbcjs().then(scheduleRender,()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('#chord-sheet-root .notation-wrap').forEach(w=>{w.textContent='Notation unavailable (could not load abcjs)'});
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-band').addEventListener('click',playWithBand);

  // Voice leading toggle
  document.getElementById('chk-voice-leading').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    favorVoiceLeading=e.target.checked;
    if(favorVoiceLeading)applyAllVoiceLeading();
    scheduleRender();
  });

  // Fingerings toggle + hand mode
  const handSel=document.getElementById('sel-hand-mode');
  document.getElementById('chk-fingerings').addEventListener('change',e=>{
    showFingerings=e.target.checked;
    handSel.classList.toggle('show',showFingerings);
    scheduleRender();
  });
  handSel.addEventListener('change',()=>{
    kbHandMode=handSel.value;
    scheduleRender();
  });
}

// ===== SHEET RENDER =====
let renderTimer=null;
function scheduleRender(){clearTimeout(renderTimer);renderTimer=setTimeout(doRender,180)}

function doRender(){
  const output=document.getElementById('sheet-output');
  const countNote=document.getElementById('count-note');
  const validTokens=parsedTokens.filter(t=>t.valid);
  const enabledInsts=DATA.instruments.filter(i=>S.instruments.get(i.id).enabled);
  if(window.__csExtras)window.__csExtras();
  const title=(document.getElementById('inp-title').value||'Chord Sheet').trim();

  if(countNote){
    countNote.textContent=validTokens.length&&enabledInsts.length
      ?`${validTokens.length} chord${validTokens.length!==1?'s':''} · ${enabledInsts.length} instrument${enabledInsts.length!==1?'s':''}`
      :!validTokens.length?'Add chords to get started':'Select at least one instrument';
  }

  output.innerHTML='';

  if(!validTokens.length||!enabledInsts.length){
    const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.className='empty-state';
    empty.innerHTML='<strong>Nothing to show yet.</strong><p>'+(
      !validTokens.length?'Type chords in the text box, or use "Add by type".':'Enable at least one instrument.'
    )+'</p>';
    output.appendChild(empty);return;
  }

  const superNow=superChords(validTokens);
  const superSecs=superOn?superSections():[];
  renderSuperPicks(superSecs.length?[]:superNow.uniq,superNow.picked);
  (function(){const el=document.getElementById('super-sections-note');if(!el)return;
    const probs=superSecs.flatMap(x=>x.bad.map(b=>'"'+b+'" in '+x.name+' is not a chord I know')).concat(superSecs.filter(x=>x.extra).map(x=>x.name+' has more than four chords; the first four are shown'));
    el.textContent=probs.join('. ')+(probs.length?'.':'')})();
  const ptitle=document.createElement('div');ptitle.className='print-sheet-title';ptitle.textContent=title;
  output.appendChild(ptitle);

  enabledInsts.forEach(inst=>{
    const ist=S.instruments.get(inst.id);
    const isKeyboard=inst.type==='keyboard';
    const tuning=isKeyboard?null:(inst.tunings.find(t=>t.id===ist.tuningId)||inst.tunings[0]||null);

    const section=document.createElement('section');section.className='inst-section';
    const heading=document.createElement('div');heading.className='inst-heading';
    heading.innerHTML=`<h3>${inst.name}</h3>${tuning?`<p>${tuning.name}</p>`:''}${showNotation&&inst.id==='guitar'?'<p class="notation-cap">Notation: guitar is written an octave above where it sounds.</p>':''}`;
    section.appendChild(heading);

    let superBlock=null;
    if(superOn&&superSecs.length){                                        // one diagram per section, each voice-led on its own
      superSecs.forEach(sec=>{
        if(!sec.tokens.length)return;
        const blk=buildSuperBlock(inst,tuning,sec.tokens);if(!blk)return;
        const nm=document.createElement('p');nm.className='super-section-name';nm.textContent=sec.name;blk.insertBefore(nm,blk.firstChild);
        if(!superBlock)superBlock=document.createElement('div');
        superBlock.appendChild(blk);
      });
    }else if(superOn)superBlock=buildSuperBlock(inst,tuning,superNow.picked);
    if(superBlock)section.appendChild(superBlock);
    const grid=document.createElement('div');
    grid.className='chord-grid'+(isKeyboard?' keyboard-grid':'');
    (superBlock&&superOnly?[]:validTokens).forEach(t=>{
      const card=buildDiagramCard(inst,tuning,t);
      if(card) grid.appendChild(card);
    });
    section.appendChild(grid);output.appendChild(section);
  });
  // abcjs measures text, so notation is drawn once the cards are in the page
  if(showNotation)output.querySelectorAll('.diagram-card').forEach(c=>{if(c._notate)c._notate()});
}

// ===== BACKING TRACK HAND-OFF =====
// "Play with the band": the progression as an ABC chart (one chord per bar), plus the voicing
// shown on each card of the first keyboard / guitar, written to localStorage.bandHandoff for
// the Backing Track page (/tools/backing-track.html), which plays exactly those notes.
function abcKeyName(){
  const name=KEY_LABELS[currentKeyContext().tonicPc];
  const mode=manualKeyPc!=null&&window.Tonality&&Tonality.getMode?Tonality.getMode():'maj';
  return name+((mode==='m'||mode==='aeo')?'m':['dor','phr','lyd','mix','loc'].includes(mode)?' '+mode:'');
}
function bandHandoffData(){
  clearTimeout(renderTimer);doRender();                    // the cards hold what is shown now
  const toks=parsedTokens.filter(t=>t.valid&&getChord(t.chordId));
  if(!toks.length)return null;
  const sym=t=>t.rootName?t.rootName+getChord(t.chordId).symbol:chordDisplayName(t.rootPc,getChord(t.chordId));
  const lines=[];
  for(let i=0;i<toks.length;i+=4)lines.push(toks.slice(i,i+4).map(t=>`"${sym(t)}"z4`).join(' | ')+(i+4>=toks.length?' |]':' |'));
  const title=(document.getElementById('inp-title').value||'Chord Sheet').replace(/[\r\n]+/g,' ').trim();
  const abc=`X:1\nT:${title}\nM:4/4\nL:1/4\nK:${abcKeyName()}\n${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
  const inst=DATA.instruments.find(i=>S.instruments.get(i.id).enabled&&(i.id==='keyboard'||i.id==='guitar'));
  const out={v:1,from:'chord-sheet',at:Date.now(),abc,comp:inst&&inst.id==='guitar'?'guitar':'piano',voicing:'standard',pins:[]};
  if(inst){
    const style=S.instruments.get(inst.id).voicingStyle||'standard';
    out.voicing=style===PLAYED?(playedVoicing||'standard'):style.startsWith('set3:')?'shell3':isLedStyle(style)?style.split(':')[1]:isPairStyle(style)?'guide2':style;
    toks.forEach((t,bar)=>{
      const midis=t.shown&&t.shown[inst.id];
      if(midis&&midis.length)out.pins.push({bar,pos:0,sym:sym(t),midis:midis.slice()});
    });
  }
  return out;
}
function playWithBand(){
  const data=bandHandoffData();
  if(!data){alert('Add some chords first.');return}
  try{localStorage.setItem('bandHandoff',JSON.stringify(data))}
  catch(e){alert('This browser blocked local storage, so the chords cannot be handed to the Backing Track page.');return}
  location.href='/tools/backing-track.html?from=chord-sheet';
}

// "As played": the Backing Track sends what its band played ({chords:[{sym,midis}],comp,voicing});
// each chord's diagram then shows exactly those notes. The caller sets the key first.
let playedVoicing=null;
function importPlayed(h){
  const chords=h.chords||[];
  if(!chords.length)return false;
  const instId=h.comp==='guitar'?'guitar':'keyboard',other=instId==='guitar'?'keyboard':'guitar';
  const ta=document.getElementById('chords-textarea');
  ta.value=chords.map(c=>String(c.sym||'').replace(/\/.*$/,'').replace(/\s+/g,'')||'?').join(' ');   // a slash bass is not drawn; the notes below carry it
  parsedTokens=[];parseTextarea();
  parsedTokens.forEach((t,i)=>{
    const m=chords[i]&&Array.isArray(chords[i].midis)?chords[i].midis.filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a,b)=>a-b):[];
    if(m.length){t.played={midis:m};const g=chords[i].strings;if(Array.isArray(g)&&g.every(x=>x&&Number.isFinite(x.string)&&Number.isFinite(x.fret)&&Number.isFinite(x.midi)))t.played.strings=g}
  });
  playedInst=instId;playedVoicing=h.voicing||null;
  const setEnabled=(id,on)=>{const u=UI[id];if(u&&u.cb.checked!==on){u.cb.checked=on;u.cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))}};
  setEnabled(other,false);setEnabled(instId,true);
  const u=UI[instId];
  if(instId==='guitar'&&u.tuningSel&&u.tuningSel.value!=='guitar-standard'){u.tuningSel.value='guitar-standard';u.tuningSel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))}
  S.instruments.get(instId).voicingStyle=PLAYED;
  u.fillStyles();u.resetStyleState();
  const note=document.getElementById('handoff-note');
  if(note){note.textContent='Loaded from the Backing Track: each diagram shows the notes its band actually played (style "As played"), with the same notes on a staff below it. Pick another style from the menu to compare.';note.style.display='block'}
  // every voicing handed over is also written out on a staff under its diagram
  const nb=document.getElementById('chk-notation');
  if(nb&&!nb.checked){nb.checked=true;nb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))}
  applyAllVoiceLeading();scheduleRender();
  return true;
}
window.ChordSheetTool={importPlayed};

// ===== BOOT =====
initUI();
renderChips();

})();
</script>
</div>
<script src="/apps/shared/pitch-spelling.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/tonality.js?v=6"></script>
<script>
// The chord-sheet tool is an IIFE, so all integration goes through the DOM:
// #chords-textarea (parsed on blur), #sel-key (the tool's key control), and the
// [data-inst-id] instrument checkboxes.
(function(){
  if (!window.Tonality) return;
  // DO / Resting are editable comboboxes: pick a suggestion or TYPE with b/#/bb/##/x.
  // Display uses ♯/♭. Spelling is line-of-fifths centered on the ANCHORED field
  // (the one last set), so B-major DO → G♯ resting, A♭-minor resting → C♭ DO, etc.
  var LET_LOF = { F:-1, C:0, G:1, D:2, A:3, E:4, B:5 };
  function parseEntry(s){
    s = (s||"").trim(); if (!s) return null;
    var m = /^([A-Ga-g])(.*)$/.exec(s); if (!m) return null;
    var L = m[1].toUpperCase(); if (!(L in LET_LOF)) return null;
    var acc = 0, rest = m[2];
    for (var i=0;i<rest.length;i++){ var c = rest[i];
      if (c==='#'||c==='♯') acc++;
      else if (c==='b'||c==='♭') acc--;
      else if (c==='x'||c==='X'||c==='𝄪') acc += 2;
      else if (c==='𝄫') acc -= 2;
      else return null;
    }
    var lof = LET_LOF[L] + 7*acc, pc = (((lof*7) % 12) + 12) % 12;
    return { pc: pc, lof: lof };
  }
  function glyph(name){ return name.replace(/x/g,"♯♯").replace(/#/g,"♯").replace(/b/g,"♭"); }
  function spellAtLof(pc, lof){
    if (window.PitchSpelling){ try { return PitchSpelling.spellPitchClass(pc, lof).name; } catch(e){} }
    return (Tonality.spellPc ? Tonality.spellPc(pc) : ["C","C#","D","D#","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","A#","B"][pc]);
  }
  // fifths offset of each mode relative to its parent major (do = (resting + mo*7) mod 12)
  var MODE = [["maj","Major",0],["m","Minor",-3],["dor","Dorian",-2],["phr","Phrygian",-4],
              ["lyd","Lydian",1],["mix","Mixolydian",-1],["loc","Locrian",-5]];
  var MO = {}; MODE.forEach(function(x){ MO[x[0]] = x[2]; });
  var mod12 = function(n){ return ((n % 12) + 12) % 12; };
  var doFromRest = function(r,m){ return mod12(r + MO[m]*7); };
  var restFromDo = function(d,m){ return mod12(d - MO[m]*7); };

  var selKey = document.getElementById("sel-key");
  var DLIST = ["C","C♯","D♭","D","D♯","E♭","E","F","F♯","G♭","G","G♯","A♭","A","A♯","B♭","B","C♭","B♯","E♯","F♭"];
  function mkNoteInput(id){
    var inp = document.createElement("input"); inp.id = id; inp.type = "text"; inp.autocomplete = "off";
    inp.setAttribute("list","cs-note-list"); inp.className = selKey ? selKey.className : "chord-type-sel";
    inp.style.minWidth = "0"; inp.style.width = "100%"; return inp;
  }
  var doInput, tonSel, restInput, building = false;
  function applyFromShared(){
    var d=Tonality.getDo(), r=Tonality.getResting(), m=Tonality.getMode();
    if (d==null) return;
    if (!MO.hasOwnProperty(m)) m = (r===d ? "maj" : "m");
    if (r==null) r = d;
    var lof = window.PitchSpelling ? PitchSpelling.keyTonicLOF(r) : 0;   // default spelling for resting; DO derived from it
    render(r, lof, false, m);
  }
  if (selKey){
    selKey.style.display = "none";                       // keep as the tool's internal key input
    var dl = document.createElement("datalist"); dl.id = "cs-note-list";
    DLIST.forEach(function(n){ var o=document.createElement("option"); o.value=n; dl.appendChild(o); });
    document.body.appendChild(dl);
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-top:2px";
    doInput = mkNoteInput("cs-do");
    tonSel = document.createElement("select"); tonSel.id="cs-tonality"; tonSel.className = selKey.className; tonSel.style.cssText = "width:100%;min-width:0";
    MODE.forEach(function(x){ var o=document.createElement("option"); o.value=x[0]; o.textContent=x[1]; tonSel.appendChild(o); });
    restInput = mkNoteInput("cs-resting");
    function field(label, el){ var d=document.createElement("div"); d.style.minWidth = "0";
      var l=document.createElement("span"); l.className="panel-sublabel"; l.textContent=label; l.style.display="block";
      d.appendChild(l); d.appendChild(el); return d; }
    wrap.appendChild(field("DO", doInput));
    wrap.appendChild(field("Tonality", tonSel));
    wrap.appendChild(field("Resting tone", restInput));
    selKey.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, selKey.nextSibling);
  }
  function driveSelKey(restPc){  // feed the tool: roman tonic = resting tone
    if (selKey && selKey.value !== String(restPc)){ selKey.value = String(restPc); selKey.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true})); }
  }
  function render(anchorPc, anchorLof, anchorIsDo, mode){
    var doPc, restPc;
    if (anchorIsDo){ doPc = anchorPc; restPc = restFromDo(anchorPc, mode); }
    else { restPc = anchorPc; doPc = doFromRest(anchorPc, mode); }
    building = true;
    if (doInput) doInput.value = glyph(spellAtLof(doPc, anchorLof));
    if (tonSel) tonSel.value = mode;
    if (restInput) restInput.value = glyph(spellAtLof(restPc, anchorLof));
    building = false;
    driveSelKey(restPc);
    return { doPc: doPc, restPc: restPc };
  }
  function publish(d, r, m){ Tonality.setAll(d, r, m, "local"); }
  if (doInput) doInput.addEventListener("change", function(){
    if (building) return; var p = parseEntry(doInput.value), m = tonSel.value;
    if (!p){ applyFromShared(); return; }
    var res = render(p.pc, p.lof, true, m); publish(res.doPc, res.restPc, m);
  });
  if (restInput) restInput.addEventListener("change", function(){
    if (building) return; var p = parseEntry(restInput.value), m = tonSel.value;
    if (!p){ applyFromShared(); return; }
    var res = render(p.pc, p.lof, false, m); publish(res.doPc, res.restPc, m);
  });
  if (tonSel) tonSel.addEventListener("change", function(){
    if (building) return; var p = parseEntry(restInput.value) || { pc: (Tonality.getResting()||0), lof: 0 }, m = tonSel.value;
    var res = render(p.pc, p.lof, false, m); publish(res.doPc, res.restPc, m);   // keep resting tone, recompute DO
  });
  Tonality.onChange(function(st, src){ if (src !== "local") applyFromShared(); });
  window.addEventListener("load", applyFromShared); applyFromShared();

  // ---- "Load tune chords": fill #chords-textarea and let the tool parse it ----
  function loadTuneChords(){
    var raw, tt;
    try { raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tuneChords")); } catch(e){}
    try { tt = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tuneTonality")); } catch(e){}
    var fb = document.getElementById("roman-feedback");
    var ta = document.getElementById("chords-textarea"); if (!ta) return;
    if (!raw || !raw.length){ if (fb) fb.textContent = "No tune chords found — open a tune first."; return; }
    // adopt the tune's DO / tonality / resting tone (also sets the key so chords
    // and romans spell per that key)
    var centerLof = window.PitchSpelling ? PitchSpelling.keyTonicLOF(Tonality.getResting() || 0) : 0;
    if (tt && tt.do != null){
      var m = MO.hasOwnProperty(tt.mode) ? tt.mode : (tt.resting === tt.do ? "maj" : "m");
      var r = tt.resting != null ? tt.resting : tt.do;
      centerLof = window.PitchSpelling ? PitchSpelling.keyTonicLOF(r) : 0;
      var res = render(r, centerLof, false, m);
      publish(res.doPc, res.restPc, m);
    }
    // re-spell each chord root per the key (the tool keeps the literal token
    // spelling for chips, so we must hand it correctly-spelled symbols)
    var spelled = raw.map(function(sym){
      var mm = /^([A-Ga-g](?:bb|##|[#bx♯♭])?)(.*)$/.exec(sym); if (!mm) return sym;
      var p = parseEntry(mm[1]); if (!p) return sym;
      return spellAtLof(p.pc, centerLof) + mm[2];   // ASCII #/b — the tool's parser handles it
    });
    ta.value = spelled.join("  ");
    ta.dispatchEvent(new Event("blur"));          // the tool parses the textarea on blur
    if (fb) fb.textContent = "";
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", function(){
    var anchor = document.getElementById("btn-add-roman");
    if (!anchor || document.getElementById("btn-load-tune-chords")) return;
    var b = document.createElement("button"); b.id="btn-load-tune-chords"; b.type="button";
    b.className = anchor.className; b.textContent = "↪ Load tune chords";
    b.style.cssText = "white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:6px";
    b.onclick = loadTuneChords;
    anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(b, anchor.nextSibling);
  });

  // ---- remember instrument settings in localStorage (default: piano/keyboard) ----
  var IK = "csInstruments";
  function saveInsts(){
    var enabled = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-inst-id]")).filter(function(c){return c.checked;}).map(function(c){return c.dataset.instId;});
    var hm = document.getElementById("sel-hand-mode");
    var st = { enabled: enabled, hand: hm ? hm.value : null,
               vl: !!(document.getElementById("chk-voice-leading")||{}).checked,
               fg: !!(document.getElementById("chk-fingerings")||{}).checked };
    try { localStorage.setItem(IK, JSON.stringify(st)); } catch(e){}
  }
  function applyInsts(){
    var st; try { st = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(IK)); } catch(e){}
    var boxes = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-inst-id]"));
    if (!boxes.length) return false;
    if (st && st.enabled){
      boxes.forEach(function(c){ var want = st.enabled.indexOf(c.dataset.instId) !== -1;
        if (c.checked !== want){ c.checked = want; c.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true})); } });
      var hm=document.getElementById("sel-hand-mode"); if (hm && st.hand){ hm.value=st.hand; hm.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true})); }
      [["chk-voice-leading","vl"],["chk-fingerings","fg"]].forEach(function(p){ var el=document.getElementById(p[0]);
        if (el && !!st[p[1]]!==el.checked){ el.checked=!!st[p[1]]; el.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true})); } });
    }
    // persist on any future change
    boxes.forEach(function(c){ c.addEventListener("change", saveInsts); });
    ["sel-hand-mode","chk-voice-leading","chk-fingerings"].forEach(function(id){ var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.addEventListener("change", saveInsts); });
    return true;
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", function(){
    if (!applyInsts()){ var n=0, t=setInterval(function(){ if(applyInsts()||++n>20) clearInterval(t); }, 100); }
  });

  // ---- "As played": /tools/chord-sheet.html?from=backing-track with localStorage.bandHandoff =
  // { v:1, from:"backing-track", at, key, comp, voicing, chords:[{ sym, midis }] }. Runs after the
  // saved instrument settings are applied, takes the key from `key`, hands the chords to the tool,
  // and removes the hand-off once read. ----
  function loadAsPlayed(){
    if (!/[?&]from=backing-track(&|$)/.test(location.search) || !window.ChordSheetTool) return;
    var h; try { h = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("bandHandoff")); } catch(e){}
    if (!h || h.from !== "backing-track") return;
    try { localStorage.removeItem("bandHandoff"); } catch(e){}
    var fb = document.getElementById("handoff-note");
    if (h.v !== 1 || !h.chords || !h.chords.length || !(Date.now() - h.at < 10*60*1000)){
      if (fb){ fb.textContent = "The Backing Track hand-off was empty or too old. Play the chart again and re-open this page from there."; fb.style.display = "block"; }
      return;
    }
    var km = /^\s*([A-Ga-g])([#b♯♭]*)\s*(.*)$/.exec(String(h.key || "C")), m = "maj";
    if (km){
      var rest = km[3].toLowerCase(), p = parseEntry(km[1].toUpperCase() + km[2]);
      if (/^(m|min)(?!aj)/.test(rest)) m = "m";
      else ["dor","phr","lyd","mix","loc"].forEach(function(x){ if (rest.indexOf(x) === 0) m = x; });
      if (p){ var res = render(p.pc, p.lof, false, m); publish(res.doPc, res.restPc, m); }
    }
    window.ChordSheetTool.importPlayed(h);
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", loadAsPlayed);
})();
</script>
